Euro Falls on Weak PMI Data and Debt Concerns — The euro dropped to $1.12, remaining close to multi-month lows following the release of weaker-than-expected PMI data, while concerns over social unrest and rising public debt across Europe continued to weigh on the currency. Flash data showed eurozone private-sector growth slowed in October to a four-month low, pressured by rising energy costs, higher interest rates and renewed contraction in France amid political and fiscal uncertainty. Consumer confidence also deteriorated more sharply than expected. Meanwhile, investors remain concerned about rising borrowing costs across Europe, particularly in France, where 10-year government bond yields reached fresh 24-year highs and the risk premium climbed to levels last seen during the 2011 eurozone sovereign debt crisis. Looking ahead, further demonstrations are expected across the region this weekend, while investors await next week’s inflation data and the ECB’s policy meeting, where rates are widely expected to remain unchanged.

Eurozone Business Activity Growth Slows — The S&P Global Eurozone Composite PMI fell to 51.9 in October 2026, down from September’s three-and-a-half-year high of 53.1 and below market expectations of 52.7, according to the preliminary estimate. Although business activity expanded for a fourth consecutive month, growth slowed to its weakest pace in the sequence, partly driven by a renewed contraction in French services activity. While strikes and unrest may have disrupted local economic activity in France, growth also eased across the rest of the eurozone, affecting both manufacturing and services. Meanwhile, new order growth weakened, bringing hiring close to stagnation, while rising energy prices drove input costs higher and prompted firms to increase selling prices. Higher interest rates also dampened demand, reinforcing concerns over slowing growth and persistent inflation that could fuel expectations of further ECB tightening. Finally, business confidence fell to a five-month low.

Euro Area Manufacturing Growth Slows to 3-Month Low — The S&P Global Eurozone Manufacturing PMI edged down to 52.4 in October 2026, its lowest level in three months, from 52.9 in September and below market expectations of 52.7. Manufacturing employment declined slightly following two consecutive months of growth. However, input purchasing continued to expand, with the pace accelerating to its joint-fastest in nearly four-and-a-half years, matching the rate recorded in April amid precautionary stockpiling linked to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. As a result, manufacturers’ stocks of purchases increased for the first time in almost four years. Meanwhile, supplier lead times lengthened significantly, marking the sharpest deterioration in four months. On the price front, input costs rose sharply in October, driven by higher energy, fuel, and transportation costs. The increase was the steepest since May and exceeded the year-to-date average.
Agricultural Commodities Updates: Rapeseed Gains by 3.11% — Top commodity gainers are Rapeseed (3.11%) and Rice (0.90%). Biggest loser is Rubber (-0.66%).

Eurozone Services Activity Growth Slows in October — The S&P Global Eurozone Services PMI fell to 51.7 in October 2026 from 53.0 in the previous month, coming in below market expectations of 52.5. This marked a two-month low, indicating a moderation in services sector growth. The pace of job creation slowed to a five-month low, reflecting weaker growth in new business and reduced pressure on operating capacity. French services activity returned to contraction, while growth also softened elsewhere in the eurozone. Services input cost inflation eased, although firms faced a less favorable business outlook amid slowing activity and persistent inflationary pressures.

Nickel Retreats on Persistent Oversupply — Nickel traded around $15,900 per tonne, reversing recent gains as persistent global oversupply and subdued demand continued to constrain prices. Indonesia’s rapid expansion of nickel production has kept supply ample, while weaker stainless steel demand and the growing use of lithium iron phosphate batteries have limited consumption growth. The International Nickel Study Group expects the global surplus to widen in 2027, reinforcing the longer-term supply overhang. Meanwhile, reports of coordinated production cuts at Chinese-operated Indonesian smelters have raised hopes of tighter supply, with producers reportedly considering halving mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) output and cutting nickel pig iron production by 20%. Although the scale and timing of the measures remain uncertain, losses among Indonesian MHP producers strengthen the incentive to curb output, potentially tightening supply if the cuts are implemented.

French Stocks Set for Weekly Decline — The CAC 40 fell 0.7% to 7,758 on Friday, extending losses from the previous session and heading for a weekly decline as investors weighed a batch of corporate earnings alongside PMI data. Luxury stocks were among the laggards, with Kering plunging 11.7% to over one-year low after Q3 2026 revenue came in flat year-on-year and down about 1% on a like-for-like basis. Hermès fell 1.1% to four-year low as its quarterly results disappointed investors amid challenging conditions in China. Safran also dropped 6.7% despite surpassing Q3 revenue growth forecasts. In contrast, L’Oréal climbed 3.5% to a more than two-year high after Q3 sales beat expectations. On the economic front, France’s flash composite PMI fell to 48.4 in October from 51.1 in September, well below forecasts of 50.5. Manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.3 from 50.6, returning to contraction and hitting an 11-month low. Services PMI also fell back into contraction, dropping to 48.4 from 51.2 and missing expectations of 50.7.

DAX at 2-Week Low — Frankfurt's DAX 40 fell 0.6% to around 25,230 on Friday, hitting a two-week low and extending the previous session’s losses. While the earnings season continues to draw investors’ attention, sentiment remained cautious amid rising oil prices due to escalating tensions in the Middle East. Also, concerns over demonstrations scheduled for Saturday in France and Italy weighed. On the data front, flash PMI figures showed that Germany’s private sector continued to expand in October, though the pace of growth slowed more than expected. Most sectors traded lower, particularly telecom, software and autos, while tech outperformed. Among individual stocks, Deutsche Telekom led the losses, falling more than 3%, followed by MTU Aero Engines, Adidas, Continental and Airbus, which declined between 1.6% and 2.6%. On the upside, Rheinmetall (2.2%), Fresenius Medical Care (1.2%), Infineon Technologies (0.9%) and Vonovia (0.9%) posted the biggest gains. For the week, the index lost around 1.5%.

FTSE MIB Extends Losses — Italy’s FTSE MIB extended its losses to around 48,300 on Friday, hovering near its lowest level since May, as losses in luxury stocks offset gains in energy shares. Eni climbed more than 3% after reporting third-quarter adjusted net profit of €2.8 billion, more than double the year-earlier figure, and announcing a €1.3 billion special dividend and an increase in its share buyback programme. Tenaris and Saipem also advanced 1.8% and 1.5%, respectively. On the downside, Moncler fell 2.1% and Brunello Cucinelli dropped 1.9%, as recent disappointing earnings from regional peers dampened hopes for a recovery in the sector. Automotive stock Stellantis also fell 2%. Investors also monitored developments in Italy’s banking sector ahead of an October 29 MPS shareholder meeting on its proposed merger with Mediobanca, amid reports of potential opposition from Banco BPM stakeholders. For the week, the benchmark index was on track to decline around 3%.

UK Gas Prices Hit Fresh Multi-Year High Amid Tight Supply — UK natural gas prices climbed toward 230 pence per therm, reaching a fresh 2022 high amid tightening global supply. Ongoing disruptions to LNG supplies from the Middle East have driven British gas prices to three times their levels at the start of the year. Adding to concerns, gas output in the North Sea, which accounts for about a third of the nation’s winter demand, is projected to fall by about 5%, according to the UK’s gas-grid operator. To compensate for this, LNG imports are forecast to increase by 5%, while Norwegian pipeline deliveries are expected to rise by 1%. While the gas network operator indicated that the country would have adequate supply capacity even under worse-case scenarios, robust LNG demand could intensify competition for cargoes and push prices even higher. Meanwhile, additional production from the newly approved Jackdaw field may offer some relief, as it is expected to start supplying gas to the UK by the end of this month.

Poland Jobless Rate Unchanged for 3rd Month — Poland’s registered unemployment rate stood at 5.8% in September 2026, in line with market expectations and unchanged for a third consecutive month. The latest result still marked the lowest level since December 2025, as the number of unemployed persons declined by 2.5 thousand from a month earlier to 907 thousand, with women representing 49.5% of the total. The majority of unemployed individuals were not entitled to unemployment benefits, accounting for 87.8% of the total. Meanwhile, 4.5% were out of work due to company-related terminations, while fresh graduates made up 3.4% of all unemployed persons. Additionally, 382.1 thousand had been out of work for more than a year. Compared with September 2025, the jobless rate was 0.2 percentage points higher, having stood at 5.6% a year earlier. Separately, reported job vacancies at the end of the month increased by 2.8 thousand to 47.2 thousand.

Germany Services Sector Growth Slows in October — Germany’s Services PMI fell to 51.7 in October 2026 from 52.9 in September, missing market expectations of 52.5, according to preliminary data. Although activity expanded for a second consecutive month, growth remained modest as demand stagnated amid delayed customer decisions and tighter client budgets. Services firms also reported a renewed decline in outstanding work. Despite easing capacity pressures at the start of the fourth quarter, companies continued to recruit, marking a third consecutive month of employment growth. However, job creation remained marginal and unchanged from September. On the price front, input cost inflation slowed, partly reflecting fuel discounts, while service providers moderated their own price increases amid competitive pressures. Looking ahead, business confidence in the services sector improved to its highest level since February, indicating stronger growth expectations despite subdued demand and limited momentum in current activity.

German Private Sector Activity Growth Slows — The S&P Global Flash Germany Composite PMI fell to 52.8 in October 2026 from 53.8 in September, below forecasts of 53.3. The reading pointed to sustained, albeit slower, growth in private-sector business activity, amid a slowdown in both the services sector (51.7 vs. 52.9) and manufacturing output (55.1 vs. 56). New business continued to expand, but did so at the weakest rate for three months. Stronger growth expectations among services firms were offset by a notable reduction in confidence in the manufacturing sector, where input cost inflation surged to its highest since May. Amid reports of competitive pressures and discounted fuel prices, however, the overall rate of increase in prices charged for goods and services ticked down to a seven-month low. In addition, the pace of job creation at services firms was unchanged and only marginal. Workforce numbers in the manufacturing sector came close to stabilising, recording only a marginal fall that was the weakest for over three years.

Germany Manufacturing Sector Growth Beats Forecasts — Germany’s Manufacturing PMI rose to 54.2 in October 2026 from 53.9 in September, exceeding market expectations of 53.5, preliminary estimates showed. This marked a two-month high and signalled a continued improvement in manufacturing business conditions. However, manufacturing output growth eased, with the output index falling to 55.1 from 56.0, its lowest level in three months. Order books continued to expand, albeit at a slower pace, supported by sustained growth in export sales, while manufacturing backlogs recorded another robust rise. Meanwhile, employment edged closer to stabilisation, with job losses slowing to their weakest pace in over three years. On the price front, input-cost inflation accelerated for a second consecutive month to its highest level since May, driven by higher oil prices and rising raw material and component costs. Looking ahead, manufacturers’ business confidence weakened to its lowest level since July amid growing concerns over rising input prices.

France Services Activity Contracts in October — The S&P Global France Services PMI fell to 48.4 in October 2026 from 51.2 in September, returning to contraction territory, according to preliminary estimates. The reading also came in below market expectations of 50.7. The downturn reflected a sharp decline in demand for services, amid heightened political uncertainty and tighter financial conditions. Business confidence also weakened, with firms' expectations for activity over the next 12 months falling to their lowest level in six and a half years.

FTSE 100 Set to End Week Lower — The FTSE 100 traded slightly lower on Friday, extending the previous session’s 0.3% decline and heading for a weekly loss of more than 1.5%. Rolls-Royce shares fell around 2.5% as the company reportedly neared a deal for up to £200 million in UK government subsidies to develop a new short-haul aircraft engine. AstraZeneca dropped over 1%, while GSK declined more than 0.5%. In contrast, Shell and BP gained 1.2% and 1.8%, respectively, as Brent crude headed for a third consecutive weekly advance amid escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia and concerns over potential supply disruptions. Meanwhile, UK consumer confidence deteriorated sharply, with the GfK index falling 11 points to -24, marking its steepest decline since the pandemic. Retail sales also disappointed in September, falling 0.4% including fuel and 0.7% excluding it month-on-month, both worse than expected. However, upward revisions to August’s figures partly offset the latest weakness.

The FTSE 100 Index Opens 0.27% Lower — The FTSE 100 Index is falling 29 points. Losses were driven by Rolls-Royce (-2.48%), Fresnillo (-2.11%) and Burberry (-1.79%). Biggest rises came from BP (1.81%), Anglo American (1.77%) and Barratt Redrow (1.53%).

The DAX Index Opens 0.57% Lower — The DAX Index is dropping 144 points. Leading the losses are MTU Aero Engines AG (-2.99%), Deutsche Telekom (-2.71%) and Adidas (-1.95%). Top gainers were Infineon (1.41%), Rheinmetall (1.05%) and HeidelbergCement (1.00%).

The CAC 40 Index Opens 0.67% Lower — The CAC 40 Index is losing 52 points. Losses were led by Kering (-11.52%), Safran (-6.16%) and Renault (-2.81%). Offsetting the fall, top gainers were L'Oréal (3.45%), TotalEnergies SE (1.59%) and Legrand (0.73%).
Rapeseed Hits 13-week High — Rapeseed increased to 564.25 EUR/T, the highest since July 2026. Over the past 4 weeks, Rapeseed lost 1.22%, and in the last 12 months, it increased 15.94%.

European Stocks Lower to End the Week — European stocks edged lower on Friday, with the STOXX 50 falling 0.3% and the STOXX 600 declining nearly 0.1%, as investors weighed rising oil prices amid escalating Middle East tensions against fresh corporate earnings updates. Kering tumbled almost 11% as Gucci sales dropped. Volvo Cars plunged nearly 25% following a sharp decline in sales in China. Safran lost 5.3% despite reporting a rise in sales. SAP was also down (-2.1%). In contrast, L'Oreal was up more than 3% after the company reported upbeat sales for Q3. SAAB shares rose 1.5% after the defence company reported better-than-expected earnings and revenue, supported by a deal to supply Gripen fighter jets to Ukraine. Meanwhile, flash PMI data showed a slowdown in private sector growth in both the Eurozone and Germany while French private-sector activity contracted. For the week, the EURO STOXX 50 lost around 1.9%, while the STOXX Europe 600 fell approximately 1%.

France Private Sector Activity Returns to Contraction — France’s S&P Global Composite PMI fell to 48.4 in October 2026 from 51.1 in September, largely missing market forecasts of 50.5, flash estimates showed. This marked a return to contraction after September’s rebound, with activity at a four-month low. New orders fell the most since May as domestic and global uncertainty prompted customers to delay projects and curb spending. Export orders also continued to shrink for an eleventh consecutive month. Moreover, employment declined for a sixth straight month as companies reduced headcounts through non-replacement of departing workers and contract non-renewals. On the price front, overall inflationary pressures eased as slower services inflation offset rising manufacturing costs, with supply-chain disruptions driving the sharpest increase in factory selling prices since May. Looking ahead, business confidence deteriorated to its lowest level since April 2020, with firms citing concerns over next year’s elections and public finances.

France Manufacturing Returns to Contraction in October — The S&P Global France Manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October 2026 from 50.6 in September, slipping back into contraction after two months of expansion and reaching an 11-month low, preliminary estimates showed. The reading also came below market expectations of 50.5, as the manufacturing output index declined to 48.5 from 50.3, signaling a renewed contraction in production. Weaker demand and heightened economic uncertainty weighed on activity, while worsening supply-chain conditions drove manufacturing price pressures higher.

Kazakhstan Unexpectedly Cuts Rates Again by 50 Bps — The National Bank of Kazakhstan lowered its base rate to 15.75% on October 23, 2026, surprising markets that had widely expected a 25 bps cut. The decision followed September’s unexpected quarter-point reduction, as annual inflation eased for a twelfth consecutive month to 9.3% amid a tight monetary policy and favorable dynamics of the tenge exchange rate. However, services inflation remained elevated at 8.9%, highlighting persistent price pressures. The NBK warned that risks remained tilted toward higher inflation, citing elevated global energy and food prices, tighter global monetary conditions and strong domestic demand. The economy grew 4.2% year over year in January-September, supported by construction, manufacturing and transport, while fiscal stimulus and robust investment continued to underpin activity. The central bank said the cut preserves moderately tight monetary conditions, with further easing unlikely before year-end. Its next rate decision is scheduled for December 4.

【中國恢復聯合國合法席位55週年，外交部：將在新歷史起點上繼續發揮負責任大國作用】10月23日，外交部發言人毛寧主持例行記者會。有記者提問，10月25日是新中國恢復聯合國合法席位55週年紀念日，請問中方如何評價55年來的歷程？未來將如何推進同聯合國合作？毛寧表示，1971年10月25日，第二十六屆聯大以壓倒性多數透過第2758號決議，決定恢復中華人民共和國在聯合國的一切權力，這標誌著佔世界人口1/4的中國人民重返聯合國舞臺，對中國、對世界、對聯合國都具有重要而深遠的意義。中國人民銘記為此向我們提供寶貴支援和幫助的友好國家和人士。55年來，中國堅持做世界和平的建設者、全球發展的貢獻者、國際秩序的維護者，我們堅定支援聯合國在國際事務中發揮核心作用，積極參與聯合國各領域工作，忠實履行安理會常任理事國職責。我們立足聯合國平臺，同各國加強團結合作，倡導共同安全，推動共同發展，促進文明對話，改革完善全球治理。站在新的歷史起點上，中國將繼續發揮負責任大國作用，持續深化同聯合國的全方位合作，共同應對全球性挑戰，攜手構建人類命運共同體。（澎湃新聞）

【西藏那曲巴青震區受損通訊、電力陸續恢復中】今天（10月23日）15時，西藏那曲市人民政府新聞辦公室舉行西藏那曲市巴青縣7.0級地震第一場新聞釋出會，通報地震災害受災情況，搜尋救援工作、轉移安置、基礎設施搶修、物資供應、醫療救治等最新情況。當地全面啟動山體、水庫、電站、河道、危舊房屋、通訊基站等重點部位24小時監測和緊急維修，震區受損通訊、電力陸續恢復中。地震、氣象、應急等部門滾動會商，及時釋出餘震和天氣預警。公安、交通全力保障救援“生命通道”暢通，已排查道路12條、1700餘公里，橋樑201座、涵洞324座，發現隱患11處，清除落石路段7處。（央視新聞）

South Korean Shares Close Higher — The benchmark KOSPI edged up 0.30% to close at 5,550 on Friday, recovering slightly from the previous session's plunge, as investors bought beaten-down semiconductor stocks. SK hynix advanced 4.42%, while Samsung Electronics rose 0.47%, alongside gains in SK Square (3.20%) and Samsung Biologics (7.71%). Retail investors also turned net buyers during the session, signaling a shift in sentiment after a sharp selloff. However, lingering concerns over returns on massive AI-related investments, compounded by overnight losses in major US technology stocks, limited the rebound. Losses in LG Energy Solution (-1.79%), Hyundai Motor (-1.99%), and KB Financial Group (-3.29%) also weighed on the index, highlighting uneven performance across large-cap stocks. At the same time, elevated oil prices amid continued Middle East tensions remained a risk, as higher energy costs could stoke inflation and increase operating expenses.

【SK海力士：會長給出“持有”建議三個月後，散戶虧損比例達74%】大約三個月前，SK集團會長崔泰源對SK海力士股票給出了“持有”的建議。但該股當前價格依舊較高點回落近60%。不少在高位附近入場的散戶深度套牢，陷入既不敢割肉、也無力加倉的境地。高位集中買入的散戶成為虧損主力。4–6月是該股行情高點區間，個人投資者淨買入規模合計31.5萬億韓元；其中6月股價創出歷史新高，單月散戶淨買入15.63萬億韓元。即便7月股價從250萬韓元區間暴跌至130萬韓元，散戶依舊淨買入9.001萬億韓元，不斷攤薄持倉成本。但後續股價進一步下探至120萬韓元附近，攤薄操作也沒能讓他們避開虧損。NH投資證券資料顯示，截至10月19日，持有SK海力士的投資者當中，74.18%處於虧損狀態。美林證券稱，按週三收盤價測算，該股明年預期市淨率僅1.10倍，處於歷史低位；如果出臺力度更強的股東回報措施，有望凸顯估值窪地。

【興業證券王涵：中國資產配置價值進一步凸顯】興業證券全球首席經濟學家王涵在接受證券時報記者採訪時表示，經過前期較為充分的調整，市場悲觀情緒已在較大程度上得到釋放。王涵表示，從中長期看，全球風險收益格局的變化，反而有望進一步凸顯中國資產的相對確定性和戰略配置價值。當前，海外經濟金融環境的不確定性正在上升，歐洲部分國家政治與財政風險交織，中東地緣局勢存在進一步升級的可能，美國科技企業大規模投資的商業化回報也開始受到市場重新審視。中國宏觀政策保持較強的連續性和穩定性，人民幣匯率展現出較強韌性，完整的產業體系、超大規模市場和豐富的應用場景構成了中國資產的獨特優勢。王涵認為，短期市場調整與中國經濟中長期發展前景之間已經出現一定程度的背離。當前中國經濟增長及企業盈利保持韌性，部分資產估值已回到具有吸引力的水平。隨著短期外部擾動逐步消化，市場有望更加充分地認識中國經濟、政策和產業發展的獨特優勢。

Japanese Stocks Pare Losses as Tech Selloff Eases — Japan’s Nikkei 225 Index fell as much as 2.3% before recovering to close 0.34% lower at 62,693 on Friday, as selling pressure in technology and artificial intelligence stocks began to ease. Despite the late-session recovery, the benchmark index declined 4% for the week, marking its second consecutive weekly loss as investors shifted away from high-performing tech and AI shares toward safer assets, including government bonds. Market sentiment was also weighed down by escalating tensions in the Middle East, following reports that the US and Israel had prepared plans for possible renewed strikes against Iran after next month’s midterm elections. Several major index constituents remained under pressure, including Taiyo Yuden (-3.9%), Disco Corp (-3.8%), Mitsubishi UFJ (-2.3%), Hitachi (-4.4%) and Nintendo (-1.8%). Meanwhile, Japan’s inflation accelerated in September, rising above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target and reinforcing expectations of another interest rate hike this year.

Rupiah Extends Weekly Losses Despite Softer Dollar — The Indonesian rupiah held near IDR 18,080 per U.S. dollar on Friday, remaining above the 18,000 mark for a third session despite broad weakness in the greenback. The dollar index hovered near a three-week low as Treasury yields fell sharply, offering limited relief to the rupiah. Locally, fiscal concerns lingered amid persistently high oil prices near USD 100 per barrel, given Indonesia’s status as a net oil importer. Worries also grew that Bank Indonesia may face a difficult trade-off between defending currency stability and supporting near-term growth. Earlier this week, Bank Indonesia kept its key interest rate unchanged for a fourth month but raised the deposit facility rate by 25bps. It also gradually slashed the reserve requirement ratio for commercial banks effective Nov. 1, adding around IDR 190 trillion to the financial system. For the week, the rupiah was on track for a second consecutive weekly decline, down around 0.7% so far, bringing its year-to-date loss to roughly 8%.

【中國駐韓大使館：請來韓團體遊客遠離低價團消費陷阱】據中國駐韓大使館，近期數箇中國旅遊團來韓旅遊期間，遭遇強制消費，因遊客不願消費或消費額度不達標，遭遇旅行社甩客，部分遊客被迫中斷行程，造成個人損失。上述情況也擾亂兩國正常旅遊秩序。      中國駐韓國大使館特此提醒來韓中國團體遊客：謹慎選擇旅行社和旅遊產品，警惕包含強制消費的不合理低價遊，避免因強制購物陷入旅遊糾紛，影響旅遊體驗和個人安全。      建議中國遊客行前應瞭解組團旅行社資質，具體可參考文化和旅遊部發布的“經營出境旅遊業務旅行社名單”。認真閱讀合同條款，同旅行社確認是否包含消費專案、是否有最低消費金額要求等。抵達韓國後，建議同地接旅行社再次確認上述資訊。

【美債週四重挫 美聯儲下週加息預期暴跌】聯邦基金期貨市場目前預計，美聯儲今年已不會再加息的機率升至了24%。與此前火熱CPI資料出爐後的市場預期相比，這堪稱是一次劇烈轉向。與此同時，債券市場也正經歷一場劇烈的重新定價：2年期美債收益率週四重挫18個基點至4.64%。最新定價顯示，針對下週的美聯儲議息會議，市場目前押注加息的機率僅為7%，創下本月新低；12月加息的機率雖仍有76%，但已不再板上釘釘；而1月份的掉期定價也僅體現了27個基點的利率上調幅度——換言之，市場目前認為美聯儲在未來三次會議上，可能只會加息一次。本輪行情的直接導火索，是AI泡沫疑似破裂的“洩氣聲”——面對維繫龐大算力所需的無底洞式資金規模，投資者的心理防線終於失守。Meta在財報與備案中丟擲資本開支需“數千億美元”的鉅額指引，直接嚇崩了市場情緒，其股價盤中應聲重挫近7%；而管理層試圖透過增設無表決權新股來配資的做法，其帶來的股權稀釋效應也招致了投資者的強烈牴觸。
【日本9月晶片製造裝置訂單額同比增長48.2%】日本半導體裝置協會（SEAJ）資料顯示，日本9月晶片製造裝置訂單額同比增長48.2%。

【花旗：Prada品牌表現堅韌抵銷Miu Miu下跌影響 維持普拉達“中性”評級】花旗釋出研報稱，普拉達第三季銷售額符合市場預期，該行維持“中性”評級，目標價39.9港元。普拉達(01913)第三季集團銷售額錄14.9億歐元，符合市場預期;撇除Versace後按固定匯率計內生增長1%，對比上季增幅7%，而市場預期為持平。當中Prada零售升1%，符合市場預期，同店銷售大致持平;Miu Miu零售跌3%，對比市場預期升1%，惟撇除中東後持平;批發業務則升12%。該行指出，，Miu Miu春夏2027系列釋出後市場反應強勁，而Versace於2027年計劃加大投資，或限制虧損收窄空間。

【日本能源白皮書：中東局勢暴露日能源體系弱點】日本政府23日釋出的2025財年（2025年4月至2026年3月）能源白皮書指出，隨著中東局勢惡化，日本能源供需結構的脆弱性再次凸顯。白皮書指出，長期以來，日本原油進口超九成依賴中東。今年2月底美國和以色列對伊朗發動軍事打擊後，作為全球能源運輸重要通道的霍爾木茲海峽通航受阻，原油及石油產品供應面臨不確定性，石腦油等部分石油相關產品的流通因此出現阻滯。（央視新聞）

【大摩績前看好Cloudflare：AI相關需求強勁，增長可持續性支撐高估值】摩根士丹利釋出Cloudflare第三季度業績前瞻報告，維持對該股的“增持”評級，目標價370美元。該行認為，消費上升、開發者採用加速以及AI/代理工作負載，正為Cloudflare提供多項增長槓桿，有望支撐Q3、Q4及2027年營收增長維持在30%區間中段。最新合作伙伴檢查顯示，CDN/應用安全、Workers、SASE及更廣泛AI領域的需求穩健，訂單管線健康，大單活動持續。
交易員預計開雲集團股價將下跌4%-8%，Tradegate平臺上該股較週四收盤價下跌7%。
【日本第24輪核汙染水排放量近8000噸】日本東京電力公司23日結束福島第一核電站第24輪核汙染水排海。本輪共排放核汙染水近8000噸。 據日本媒體23日報道，福島第一核電站2026財年第6輪也是總計第24輪核汙染水排海始於本月5日，總計排放核汙染水約7852噸，含放射性氚總量約1.2萬億貝克勒爾。24輪核汙染水排海總計排放量達18.84萬噸。(新華社)
【日本9月半導體裝置訂單額同比增長48.2%】日本半導體裝置協會資料顯示，日本9月半導體裝置訂單額同比上漲48.2%。半導體裝置訂單額環比上漲5.2%；訂單額為6290.4億日元。

【深圳：9月份出口3402.58億元 增長40.2%】深圳市統計局釋出資料，前三季度，全市進出口總額46528.17億元，同比增長38.8%。其中，出口24085.03億元，增長18.5%；進口22443.14億元，增長70.1%。高新技術產品出口增長29.3%。9月份，進出口總額6634.79億元，同比增長65.2%。其中，出口3402.58億元，增長40.2%；進口3232.21億元，增長103.5%。

【許正宇：香港“代幣化”正邁向落地實施階段】香港財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇指出，香港“代幣化”進展正從“實驗階段”邁向“落地實施階段”。他指，目前香港匯聚了超過1400家金融科技企業，其中包括8家虛擬銀行、4家虛擬保險公司，以及12家持牌虛擬資產交易平臺，在推進“代幣化”方面取得優異成績。許正宇提到，港交所(00388)正致力於在明年啟動一個代幣化倉單融資試點計劃，該專案將與指定銀行合作，利用分散式帳本技術(DLT)，推動將大宗商品倉單用作抵押品。此外，港交所亦正在建立一個多資產代幣化平臺，其中包括來自認可倉庫的大宗商品倉單。
【深圳：9月份社會消費品零售總額900.66億元 同比增長7.6%】深圳市統計局釋出深圳前三季度經濟資料。前三季度，全市社會消費品零售總額7733.14億元，同比增長2.3%，比上半年加快1.1個百分點。9月份，社會消費品零售總額900.66億元，同比增長7.6%，比上月加快2.5個百分點。分消費型別看，商品零售增長1.9%；餐飲收入增長4.9%。

【年內12只新股首日收益破10萬，最高單籤盈利超55萬】按上市日期統計，截至2026年10月22日，年內A股已上市新股130家，相較去年同期的82家增長約59%，實際募資合計約2255.60億元。新股的“賺錢效應”也持續吸引投資者目光。從資料來看，2026年A股上市新股首日無一例破發，投資者只要中籤必賺。如果按上市首日最高漲幅來計算，年內有12只新股上市首日收益突破10萬元，分別是頻準鐳射（55.66萬元）、宇樹科技（47.46萬元）、聯訊儀器（38.90萬元）、長進光子（32.40萬元）、鴻富誠（27.66萬元）、臻寶科技（27.22萬元）、中塑股份（26.24萬元）、超純應材（24.44萬元）、燧原科技（16.64萬元）、託倫斯（12.09萬元）、大普微（10.45萬元）、高凱技術（10.03萬元）。

【商務部新聞發言人就美國防部公佈所謂科研安全審查結果事答記者問】有記者問：美東時間10月19日，美國防部公佈對部分美國高校的科研安全審查結果，提到相關高校已全面終止與1286清單實體的合作關係。1286清單實體中，包括很多中國科研機構。請問商務部對此有何評論？答：我們注意到有關情況。中方一貫反對美方泛化國家安全概念，將科研領域交流合作政治化、武器化、工具化，並對中國科研機構進行無理的“汙名化”指責。美方相關做法實質上是在脅迫美國科研機構“選邊站隊”，蓄意破壞中美正常科研合作，這隻會削弱美自身的科技進步與創新發展，搬起石頭砸自己的腳。中美加強科研合作符合雙方共同利益，搞限制“脫鉤”只會損人害己。中方敦促美方尊重事實，順應全球科技交流合作的普遍規律與時代潮流，立即停止對中國科研機構採取歧視性、限制性措施的錯誤做法。中方將採取必要措施，維護中國科研機構的正當合法權益。
【密爾克衛：“All in AI”戰略達到一定效果，從第四季度開始將逐步顯現】密爾克衛在2026年第三季度業績說明會上表示，目前“All in AI”的戰略實施達到了一定效果，從第四季度開始將逐步顯現。公司切入半導體物流領域無需大額資本開支，用公司現有的核心資源和核心能力，即可滿足客戶的需求。

【摩根大通：國有內銀第三季料再錄強勁業績 降郵儲銀行評級至“中性”】摩根大通釋出研報稱，看好國有大型銀行第三季業績，預期國有大行仍可繼續跑贏大市；該行將郵儲銀行(01658)評級由“增持”降至“中性”，2027年12月目標價維持5.9港元不變。該行指出，國有大行第三季收入增長料由淨利息收入同比增約10%帶動，淨息差大致穩定、生息資產同比高個位數增長;手續費收入或因高基數而偏弱，但五大行投資收益料受惠近期IPO(如長鑫)部分公允價值收益入賬。股份制銀行方面，料招商銀行(03968)及中信銀行(00998)收入及盈利走勢相對平穩。
【香港天文臺錄得最高氣溫31.2攝氏度，繫有記錄以來最熱霜降】據香港電臺網10月23日訊息，受乾燥的東北季候風影響，廣東天氣晴朗，香港下午天氣炎熱，截至下午1時半，香港天文臺錄得最高氣溫31.2攝氏度，是有記錄以來最熱的霜降。天文臺預測，週末期間天晴及非常乾燥，日夜溫差頗大。

【印尼央行稱通脹目標與印尼盾仍是政策決議核心考量】印尼央行仍將通脹作為政策最終目標。儘管全球市場波動，通脹預計維持在1.5%-3.5%目標區間內。央行經濟與貨幣政策執行主任菲爾曼·莫赫塔爾週五在雅加達對記者表示，央行持續監測印尼盾走勢，目前匯率水平尚不存在突破通脹目標的風險。印尼央行將持續最佳化貨幣政策工具，增強對外韌性，並將採取“必要的政策調整”維護穩定，支撐經濟增長。央行加大對沖激勵措施，吸引資金流入、穩定印尼盾匯率。他稱，這類激勵工具是輔助手段，不能替代政策利率，共同服務於錨定通脹目標。
【深圳前三季度固定資產投資降幅收窄 高技術產業投資增長較快】深圳市統計局釋出深圳前三季度經濟資料。前三季度，全市固定資產投資同比下降5.2%，比上半年降幅收窄9.4個百分點；扣除房地產開發投資，全市固定資產投資增長3.1%。基礎設施投資增長16.9%，房地產開發投資下降23.2%，工業投資增長4.3%，其中，工業技術改造投資增長20.2%。高技術製造業投資同比增長18.0%。
中證1000指數期貨連續主力合約日內漲3%，現報6665.80點。
【花旗：維持安踏體育“買入”評級 目標價107港元】花旗釋出研報稱，安踏體育(02020)2026年第三季度其他品牌增長好於預期。管理層維持2026年全年指引，預計第四季度零售銷售將較第三季度環比改善。該行維持安踏體育“買入”評級，目標價107港元。

【土耳其議會透過基金清盤法案】據報道，安卡拉議會透過投資基金清盤相關法案。相關條款不作為基金通用監管規則，僅適用於9月17日起進入清盤程式的基金。法案目標是在清盤過程中為基金持有人爭取儘可能高的資產價值。9月17日及之前提交賣出申請、但交易在Tefas基金平臺被凍結的投資者納入本次清盤範圍。交易中被認定存在市場欺詐行為的人員，將無法獲得任何兌付資金。向投資者發放的臨時兌付款，單人上限100萬里拉（摺合2萬美元）。部分投資者此前已成功贖回，回款金額高於本金加通脹差額，該類人員需退還超額部分。
【多隻創業板ETF漲超4% 早盤一度跌超3%】午後創業板翻紅並持續反攻，創業板50ETF華夏、創業板ETF匯添富、創業板ETF廣發等多隻創業板ETF漲超4%。

【上海光機所在低閾值紫藍光鈣鈦礦鐳射研究中取得進展】據中國科學院上海光機所訊息，近日，中國科學院上海光學精密機械研究所超強鐳射科學與技術全國重點實驗室聯合國科大杭州高等研究院、上海科技大學研究團隊，在寬禁帶鹵化物鈣鈦礦增益介質與高效能紫藍光鐳射領域取得突破。研究提出動態分子構象異構驅動滷離子交換全新制備路線，攻克長期制約紫藍光鈣鈦礦鐳射器的結晶不均、高缺陷、相分離、閾值高、穩定性差等痛點，實現了目前國際最優的423 nm紫藍光鹵化物鈣鈦礦鐳射效能輸出。
【深圳前三季度經濟資料出爐 GDP同比增長6.0%】深圳市統計局釋出深圳前三季度經濟資料。根據廣東省地區生產總值統一核算結果，2026年前三季度全市地區生產總值30250.85億元，按不變價格計算，同比增長6.0%。其中，第一產業增加值20.09億元，增長1.6%；第二產業增加值11020.06億元，增長7.3%；第三產業增加值19210.70億元，增長5.4%。
【約旦河西岸發生襲擊事件致2死5傷】據以色列媒體23日報道，約旦河西岸南部城市希伯倫附近當天發生襲擊事件，造成5名以色列人受傷。2名巴勒斯坦襲擊者被以軍開槍打死。（新華社）
【深圳前三季度經濟資料出爐 GDP同比增長6.0%】深圳市統計局釋出深圳前三季度經濟資料。根據廣東省地區生產總值統一核算結果，2026年前三季度全市地區生產總值30250.85億元，按不變價格計算，同比增長6.0%。其中，第一產業增加值20.09億元，增長1.6%；第二產業增加值11020.06億元，增長7.3%；第三產業增加值19210.70億元，增長5.4%。
蔚來：2026年10月23日，蔚來在陝西西安完成了第160,000臺蔚來全新ES8交付。
鹿島公司：業務運營範圍被勒令暫停的是從11月7日起120天內，全國範圍內從事私營部門土木工程新合同的業務活動。
科創50日內漲幅達3.03%，成分股中，沐曦股份漲12.72%，摩爾執行緒漲10.21%，影石創新漲8.61%，中控技術漲8.00%。

【招商證券張靜靜：預計全年出口增長19%，出口需求改善向部分傳統消費品擴散】9月進出口總額51628億元，同比增長27.5%。其中，出口30344億元。招商證券研發中心宏觀首席張靜靜對此表示，這主要是由於汽車出口重新提速，傳統消費品的改善也更加廣泛，數量增長開始提供更多支撐，顯示出口需求改善已開始向部分傳統消費品擴散。她預計，考慮全球AI投資需求延續、汽車出口數量擴張以及傳統消費品改善範圍擴大，將全年出口增長基準上修至19%左右較為合理。

Danish Retail Sales Growth Picks Up in September — Retail sales in Denmark rose 4.4% year-on-year in September 2026, accelerating from an upwardly revised 3.9% increase in the previous month. Sales grew at a faster pace for consumer electronics (21.7% vs 20.1% in August), supermarkets, department stores, and specialized grocery stores (1.5% vs 1.3%), household equipment, furniture, and building materials (8.9% vs 6.9%), clothing, footwear, and jewelry (9.6% vs 7.9%), and second-hand goods (26.6% vs 19.3%). On the other hand, growth moderated for cultural and leisure products (10.8% vs 13.3%) and pharmaceuticals and personal care products (4.3% vs 5.8%). Moreover, sales declined at a faster pace at liquid fuel filling stations (-17.0% vs -16.8%). On a seasonally adjusted monthly basis, retail sales increased 0.4%, rebounding from a 0.3% fall in August.

European Stocks Poised to Open Higher — European equity markets were set to open slightly higher on Friday following a sharp decline in the previous session, as investors continued to evaluate the outlook for AI investments. Global equities came under heavy selling pressure on Thursday amid growing concerns over the sustainability of massive AI spending, prompting investors to seek the relative safety of bonds. Rising oil prices, driven by escalating tensions in the Middle East, also kept market sentiment cautious. In Europe, attention will turn to UK retail sales figures and preliminary manufacturing and services activity data from across the region. On the corporate front, Italian energy giant Eni announced plans to increase shareholder returns as the conflict in the Middle East pushed energy prices higher, while Swedish automaker Volvo reported solid third-quarter earnings, supported by improving demand in North America and Europe. In premarket trading, Euro Stoxx 50 and Stoxx 600 futures both gained around 0.1%.

ASX 200 Ends Flat, Posts First Weekly Loss in 4 Weeks — The ASX 200 closed nearly flat at 8,795 on Friday, reversing a modest decline in the prior session as traders assessed flash PMI data showing a further contraction in Australian factory activity and a deeper downturn in services in October. Meanwhile, U.S. stock futures fell after the Nasdaq posted its steepest daily decline since June Thursday, as high-profile earnings reignited concerns over AI spending. BHP Group tumbled 3.6% amid a sharp drop in copper production and regulatory concerns over Chinese trade agreements. Goodman Group also shed 3.6% amid mounting regulatory scrutiny and concerns over power-grid capacity for Australia's data center infrastructure. In contrast, the four major banks rose between 0.9%–4.4%, benefiting from a defensive rotation away from materials and tech stocks. For the week, the index eased 0.1%, snapping three straight weekly rises, on concerns over a potential fifth interest rate hike this year following hawkish comments from RBA Deputy Gov. Hauser.

【紅果短劇上線防沉迷提醒影片】從紅果方面獲悉，近日，紅果短劇上線“休息提醒”和“睡眠提醒”兩項機制。“休息提醒”在使用者看劇超過一定時長後觸發：在劇集播放頁，螢幕上方會出現“是時候休息下啦”的提示；在推薦頁，使用者則會刷到一條提醒影片，提醒影片由賀平生、姜月初、趙一帆、陳子昂等多位短劇虛擬角色出鏡。“睡眠提醒”則面向深夜時段仍在看劇的使用者。目前，提醒機制正逐步覆蓋更多使用者。據瞭解，紅果短劇後續還將上線“時間管理”功能，使用者可以按照自己的作息，自行設定休息提醒的間隔和睡眠提醒的時間。

【上海：降低智慧要素使用成本】上海市經濟和資訊化委員會印發《上海市加快推動人工智慧賦能工業服務業高質量發展行動方案（2027—2028年）》，其中提出，降低智慧要素使用成本。支援企業呼叫雲平臺部署的第三方大模型API，或採用第三方大模型私有化部署方式，推進大模型垂類應用，給予最高500萬元補貼。鼓勵工業智算雲平臺向工業服務業企業提供低程式碼智慧體開發平臺，推出算力惠企方案。支援企業租用非關聯方智算資源開展大模型、智慧體研發與應用，給予最高30%租用補貼。支援企業購買高質量語料進行模型、智慧體研發與應用，給予最高500萬元補貼。

Danish Business Morale Hits 18-Month High — Denmark’s manufacturing confidence indicator climbed to 102.7 in October 2026 from 100.5 in the previous month. The latest result moved further above the long-term average of 100 and marked the highest reading since April 2025. Production expectations strengthened to 22 from 15, while employment expectations eased to 2 from 5. On the broader front, the business confidence indicator, covering industry, construction, services and retail, fell to 104.5 from 107.1. Construction sentiment weakened, with its gauge declining to 100.6 from 101.5, while the services measure dropped to 104.9 from 107.3 as revenue expectations fell to 8 from 12 and employment expectations slipped to 1 from 4. Retail optimism recorded the sharpest decline, with its indicator plunging to 103.7 from 114.8. Although revenue expectations remained relatively strong at 29, retail employment expectations turned negative, falling to -3 from 9.

UK Retail Sales Fall More Than Expected — UK retail sales volumes fell 0.4% month-on-month in September 2026, more than the expected 0.1% decline, following an upwardly revised 0.7% rise in August. The drop reflected weaker demand for autumn and winter clothing ranges amid unseasonably warm weather, alongside lower footfall and consumer cutbacks that weighed on non-food retailers. Online clothing sales weakened, while supermarket sales declined after increasing in July and August. Non-food store sales volumes dropped 0.4%, with clothing and footwear, sports equipment and household goods retailers recording declines. In contrast, automotive fuel sales rose despite higher prices. Over the third quarter, retail sales volumes increased 0.7% from the previous quarter and 1.5% year-on-year, supported by higher fuel and food store sales, warm weather, and stronger sales of alcohol and beverages linked to promotions and the World Cup. Annually, retail sales volumes rose 0.8% in September.

【萬聯證券酈彬：A股情緒集中釋放後定價將回歸基本面】萬聯證券研究所所長酈彬認為，當前A股市場情緒集中釋放，隨著“9·29”一攬子宏觀新政及近期金融街論壇系列增量政策逐步顯效，第四季度消費與投資企穩回升動能堅實，疊加三季報結構性業績亮點頻現、市場估值處於高價效比區間、中長期資金加速入市，市場信心有望迎來實質性修復，可以把握歲末年初配置視窗的時機。酈彬表示，客觀審視近期全球市場波動可以發現，儘管近期中美股市表面上呈現同頻調整，但其背後的調整邏輯存在本質差異，海外風險因素與A股基本面的直接關聯度相對有限。近期A股調整，更多是在外部情緒擾動下，場內部分存量資金因連續回撥影響帶來交易行為變化，微觀交易結構階段性走弱，帶動市場情緒趨於謹慎。隨著短期情緒層面的拋壓逐步消化，市場定價將更多回歸國內紮實的基本面與政策面。

【光大證券王開：A股市場的制度建設正從應對波動走向塑造韌性和常態化賦能】光大證券首席資產配置分析師王開表示，證監會主席吳清近日在2026金融街論壇年會上發表主旨講話，釋放的積極訊號不止在於短期提振信心，更在於回答了一個根本的問題——市場穩定靠什麼。短期靠穩市機制防風險，中期靠長線資金和機構化程序增韌性，長期靠投融資協調改革、上市公司提質增效和高水平開放提質量。把這三層連起來看，A股市場的制度建設正在從應對波動走向塑造韌性和常態化賦能。當政策託底、資金結構最佳化和盈利修復同向發力，市場信心就更有條件轉為內生修復，邁向長期投資決策。

【受颱風影響 福建沿海56條客渡運航線停航 轉移13.41萬人】今天，受颱風“薔琵”影響，福建沿海出現8級及以上大風。根據福建省氣象臺預報，今天，閩東、閩中、閩南漁場和釣魚島海域最大風力9—11級、陣風11—13級；臺灣淺灘、閩外漁場及中北部沿海海區最大風力8—10級、陣風10—12級。福建省防汛抗旱指揮部維持防颱風三級應急響應。為了確保安全，截至23日11時，福建沿海共有56條客渡運航線、130艘客渡船停航，其中，4條兩岸“小三通”客運航線全部停航。111個水上施工作業專案全部停工。福建海事局已調派部署專業大型救助船、海巡船艇、應急拖輪等海上應急力量靠前值守，隨時做好應急搶險準備。目前，福建全省海上漁船和沿海養殖漁排上的人員已全部撤離，全省累計轉移海上、陸上危險區域群眾13.41萬人。
【機構：預估2026年全球光纖供需缺口將達1.8億芯公里】根據TrendForce集邦諮詢最新通訊產業研究，隨著AI資料中心、跨資料中心互連及高容量骨幹網路建設推升光纖需求，預估2026年全球光纖供需缺口將達1.8億芯公里，供給緊縮將帶動光纖成品現貨價格年增2.8至5倍以上。為此，電信廠商開始逐步調整採購模式，從短期轉向長約佈局，以提前鎖定光纖資源。

【日本能源白皮書：中東局勢暴露日本能源體系弱點】日本政府23日釋出的2025財年（2025年4月至2026年3月）能源白皮書指出，隨著中東局勢惡化，日本能源供需結構的脆弱性再次凸顯。 白皮書指出，長期以來，日本原油進口超九成依賴中東。今年2月底美國和以色列對伊朗發動軍事打擊後，作為全球能源運輸重要通道的霍爾木茲海峽通航受阻，原油及石油產品供應面臨不確定性，石腦油等部分石油相關產品的流通因此出現阻滯。 為保障國內能源供應，日本政府自3月以來採取了釋放石油儲備、加大從中東以外地區替代採購力度等措施。白皮書認為，這些措施幫助日本確保了原油供應。但與此同時，部分石油相關產品出現了因市場對供應前景擔憂而引發的囤積庫存情況，導致流通不暢和供應分佈不均。 白皮書認為，日本在上世紀70年代石油危機以後數十年間建立的能源危機應對機制，已難以應對新的能源供應風險。 日本政府通常在每年6月前後釋出能源白皮書，今年為納入中東局勢變化情況及相關應對措施，推遲至10月釋出。(新華社)

NZX 50 Ends Slightly Lower, Posts Weekly Loss — The NZX 50 shed 13 points, or 0.1%, to close at 13,734 on Friday, extending losses from the previous session and tracking a fall on Wall Street overnight as a tech-sector selloff deepened. Caution prevailed ahead of the RBNZ’s monetary policy decision next week, as well as the Fed’s interest rate decision. Although annual inflation slowed to 3.7% in Q3, caution persisted amid expectations that inflation would rise again following a temporary dip in fuel prices. Inflation also remained above the RBNZ’s 1–3% target range. Rising oil prices further pressured sentiment, raising concerns over inflation expectations and interest rate hikes. The materials, technology, and energy sectors mainly weighed on the index, with the biggest losses recorded by Fletcher Building (-4.8%), Summerset Group (-3.2%), Henderson Far East Income (-2.7%), EBOS Group (-1.9%), Contact Energy (-1.1%), and Infratil (-1.0%). For the week, the index edged down 0.1% after being almost flat in the previous week.

【華創證券首席經濟學家張瑜：產業創新的載體正在重構A股的盈利結構與估值錨】華創證券首席經濟學家張瑜表示，資本市場信心的重建，長期需要落腳到企業盈利與產業創新上。產業創新對A股長期價值的賦能，本質上是把“成長性”切實轉化為“盈利性”，讓指數的上漲有利潤的支撐、有產業的根基。中游裝備製造業甚至更廣義的新經濟，正是這條邏輯下最清晰的載體。張瑜表示，產業創新的載體，即中游裝備製造業和更廣義的新經濟，正在重構A股的盈利結構與估值錨。產業競爭力和附加值的提升帶來利潤率和ROE的提升，進而帶來新經濟的市值佔比與指數中樞的長期抬升。制度完善為市場提供環境，產業創新為市場提供盈利，二者共振，A股長期價值的根基就會越扎越牢。

Singapore Inflation Rate Edges Lower — Singapore’s annual inflation rate edged down to 2.2% in September 2026 from market expectations and August's more than two-year low of 2.3%. Price growth notably moderated for transport (7.4% vs 8.1% in August), clothing and footwear (2.1% vs 3.1%), and household durables and services (0.2% vs 1.2%). In contrast, inflation slightly picked up for food (2.4% vs 2.3%) and housing and utilities (1.4% vs 1.3%). On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.2%, slowing from 0.6% in August. Singapore’s core inflation eased to 2% in September from 2.2% in August, undershooting market expectations of 2.3% as the import-reliant economy weathered renewed global oil price pressures. The slowdown supported the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s recent decision to keep monetary policy unchanged. The central bank also lowered its core inflation forecast for this year to 1.5%-2%, from a previous projection of up to 2.5%, while maintaining its outlook for headline inflation at around 2%.

【西藏巴青7.0級地震 交通運輸部啟動公路交通突發事件三級應急響應】10月22日22時33分許，西藏那曲市巴青縣發生7.0級地震。交通運輸部高度重視，堅決貫徹落實習近平總書記重要指示精神和李強總理批示要求，迅速部署地震應對工作，於23日9時啟動公路交通突發事件三級應急響應，派出工作組趕赴現場，指導西藏自治區交通運輸部門全力做好搶險救援和公路保通保暢等工作。商財政部按照快速核撥機制，安排公路應急搶通資金予以支援。西藏自治區交通運輸廳在地震發生後即啟動二級應急響應，組織當地公路部門安排178人、機械裝置39臺，針對受影響的G317、G349、G345、G558、G562，S301、S205、S208、S209、S302、S506、S303等路段迅速開展排查，目前，已排查公路2377公里、橋樑295座、涵洞635道。經排查，G345、S301部分路段不同程度出現災損，震區公路已採取交通管制措施，救援車輛可保障通行，社會車輛暫不允許通行。

India Manufacturing Growth Slightly Eases — India's HSBC Manufacturing PMI edged down to 54.9 in October 2026 from 55.1 in the previous month, indicating continued growth in factory activity, albeit at a slower pace. Manufacturing output and new orders continued to expand at broadly unchanged rates, while new export orders increased at their fastest pace since June 2025. Manufacturers increased their stocks of purchases at the fastest rate in eight months, while finished goods inventories rose at the sharpest pace on record as firms responded to stronger new orders. However, growth in purchasing activity eased to its slowest pace since the current expansion began in July 2021. Manufacturing employment increased only slightly as firms had sufficient staffing capacity to handle workloads. On prices, manufacturing input cost inflation eased, while selling price inflation slowed to its weakest pace in almost four years.

【歐洲議會宣佈：今年第四個代表團將於下週訪華，討論中歐經貿等問題】據歐洲議會網站22日訊息，歐洲議會國際貿易委員會議員代表團將於下週訪問中國，討論中歐經貿政策，同時探索對話的機會。歐洲議會訊息稿稱，這是歐洲議會國際貿易委員會代表團第二次訪問中國（上次是在2018年），也是歐洲議會今年派遣的第四個訪華代表團。 訊息稿稱，此次代表團由歐洲議會國際貿易委員會主席、社會民主黨黨團成員貝恩德·朗格率領，他們將於10月27日至29日前往北京、杭州和上海。訪問期間，他們預計將與中方官員會面，並參訪中國高科技企業。（環球網）

India Private Sector Growth Picks Up in October — India’s HSBC Composite PMI rose to 56.7 in October 2026 from a final 55.9 in the prior month, flash data showed. It was the fastest growth in private-sector activity since June, with the services sector accelerating while factory output stayed resilient. New orders quickened, and foreign sales increased the most in six months, reflecting robust demand from the U.S., the UK, the Middle East and Bangladesh. However, employment rose at its slowest pace this year. Backlogs of work fell for the third time in four months, with the pace of depletion matching August 2021’s 6-1/2-year high and ranking among the sharpest since the global financial crisis. Price pressures continued to ease, as input cost inflation slowed for a seventh straight month to its lowest in near a year, while output price inflation hit its lowest since March 2025. Looking ahead, confidence reached its highest since May on expectations of stronger market conditions, although it remained below the average for 2026 so far.

【日企就引發蒙古國大火道歉 】據日本廣播協會（NHK）今天（10月23日）報道，日本電信運營商凱迪迪愛（KDDI）公司就造成蒙古國自然保護區大規模草原火災道歉。 據NHK報道，凱迪迪愛公司發表宣告道歉，稱其子公司莫比康的相關活動引發了火災，表示“深刻認識到此次事件對蒙古國的自然環境造成了巨大影響”，將支援莫比康配合蒙古國方面的調查。據凱迪迪愛解釋稱，莫比康的日籍執行長越智康博等人曾駕車進入保護區進行“通訊測試”，結果引發火災。

Sensex Falls for Fourth Straight Session — India’s BSE Sensex edged down about 0.4% to 72,970 on Friday, extending losses for a fourth consecutive session as surging crude oil prices and escalating geopolitical tensions continued to weigh on sentiment. Brent crude climbed to $113.50 a barrel amid heightened Middle East tensions and concerns over potential supply disruptions following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. Elevated oil prices pose risks to India’s import bill, inflation outlook, and corporate margins, keeping investors wary. Meanwhile, gains in technology stocks, following an overseas rebound after a sell-off in AI-linked shares, provided limited support. Most sectors opened in negative territory, with technology the only sector posting gains. Shares of Infosys, TCS, HCL Tech, and Wipro rose between 1.6% and 3.1%. Among notable laggards included State Bank of India (-0.6%), Cupid (-4.2%), Tech Mahindra (-0.9%), and BSE (-1.2%). For the week to date, the benchmark is on track for a 2.4% decline.

【新加坡交易所羅文才計劃在任職十年後交棒】新加坡交易所執行長羅文才表示，隨著交易所邁入下一增長階段，他準備卸任。羅文才在週五的公司年度大會上稱：“我們已有清晰的戰略方向、精幹的領導團隊，以及推動新交所繼續發展的勢頭。基於此，我近期已告知董事長，應當提前規劃執行長職位的交接事宜。”羅文才曾任美國銀行亞太環球市場主管，2015 年 7 月出任新交所執行長。這位資本市場資深人士稱，其合約持續至 2027 年 7 月。新交所 8 月披露業績，營收與淨利潤創下上市以來新高，股票、外匯、大宗商品業務全線增長，公司同時宣佈派發一次性特別股息。

【中際旭創：預計1.6T、800G等高階光模組需求將保持快速增長】中際旭創午間釋出關於公司近期生產經營情況的公告，公司目前生產經營一切正常，供應鏈穩定，產能利用率充足，客戶訂單需求強勁。2017 年-2025 年，公司營業收入從23.57億元增長至382.40億元，年均複合增長率為41.67%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤從1.62億元增長至107.97億元，年均複合增長率69.03%。2026年上半年營業收入417.78億元，同比增長182.49%；歸屬於上市公司股東的淨利潤136.51億元，同比增長241.70%。在未來的經營發展中，公司將利用現有優勢資源持續拓展光互連解決方案，緊抓行業快速發展的契機，持續強化技術創新、快速量產、規模優勢、質量保障等核心競爭力，進一步最佳化和拓寬公司高階產品系列，保持經營業績穩健前行。

下游需求保持高景氣，公司在手訂單飽滿。海外市場方面，主要客戶訂單已下至2027年，部分重點客戶已給出2028年需求的明確指引，預計1.6T、800G等高階光模組需求將保持快速增長，NPO、XPO等下一代光互連產品需求亦有望逐步釋放。國內市場方面，AI算力基礎設施建設快速推進，400G、800G等產品需求亦有望進一步增長。

光互連技術持續迭代，行業技術壁壘有望進一步提升。公司將圍繞scale-out、scale-up、scale-across 和 scale-in 等全場景網路架構，積極開發下一代光互連解決方案，進一步加大對1.6T、3.2T及更高速率光模組的研發投入，同時積極開發NPO、XPO等下一代產品，目前已在部分產品上與重點客戶開展合作研發與送樣。依託公司在矽光、TFLN、相干等核心技術領域多年的沉澱和先發優勢，公司將持續鞏固技術領先地位，加快推進下一代產品的研發與產業化程序。

【央視曝光養生鈦製品背後貓膩 你買的鈦製品可能是鍍鈦】從保溫杯、湯鍋到餐盤餐具，鈦制生活用品熱度持續走高。這些商品往往宣稱具有抑菌、保鮮、活化食材等作用，各類養生概念鋪天蓋地。但是同樣打著“鈦”標籤的產品，從一兩百元到一兩千元，價格卻相差不少，普通消費者很難分辨材質真偽與宣傳虛實。 南京工業大學材料科學與工程學院教授常輝介紹，價格便宜的鈦製品很可能是鍍鈦、覆鈦產品，通常是不鏽鋼或鋁，而非鈦合金或純鈦，與整體純鈦有本質區別。“塗層因為跟基體的結合強度可能不太一致，或出現脫落，一旦脫落之後，最大的風險就是在水杯裡面或者鍋具裡面會析出一些重金屬，對人體的健康造成一定危害。” 在宣傳中，還有的商家稱鈦杯可以改變水質酸鹼度、產生富氫水。專家表示，這些從科學上來講應該都是噱頭，沒有什麼科學依據。 專家表示，把鍍鈦產品冒充純鈦售賣、誇大養生功效，涉嫌虛假宣傳，嚴重的構成消費欺詐。直播間、商品頁宣傳不一致，電商平臺也要負相應的責任。（央視財經）

【滙豐上線首枚穩定幣RedCoin 年內可用於認購代幣化投資產品】從滙豐獲悉，滙豐今日在PayMe by HSBC上線首枚穩定幣 “滙豐RedCoin”（簡稱 RCHKD）。上線後的數天內，超過330萬名PayMe使用者可在應用程式內開通穩定幣錢包，支援兩類支付場景：個人對個人轉賬，使用者可透過PayMe向親友即時劃轉穩定幣；個人對商戶支付，可直接在超10萬家合作商戶消費結算。滙豐還計劃在今年晚些時候，在滙豐香港流動理財應用程式(HSBCHK Mobile Banking App)加入穩定幣錢包功能，客戶後續可使用匯豐 RedCoin認購代幣化投資產品，其中包含滙豐港元貨幣市場基金新股份類別。這也是香港金管局批出的首批兩張穩定幣牌照對應的產品之一，另一張牌照由渣打牽頭設立的合資公司碇點金融持有，該機構發行的港元穩定幣HKDAP已於今年8月率先推出。

【震盪市中壓艙石：紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）半日成交4.78億元居同類首位 近5年回報50.17％】10月23日，市場早間震盪調整，創業板指跌超2％，滬指跌1.20％。在此背景下，紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）逆勢上漲0.08％，報1.203元，換手率1.57％，半日成交額4.78億元，居同類標的ETF首位。中金公司表示，回顧過去幾年投資結構，從紅利、科技、科技成長啞鈴，自下而上的個股機會成為影響因素，即銀行股更容易在反直覺的承壓環境下跑贏。考慮當前高股息依然是銀行板塊上漲的核心邏輯，增量資金需求一方面來自險資的中長期配置需求，另一方面來自年底降低組合波動性的交易性資金需求，故銀行個股層面，建議關注幾條主線：1）業績與股息兼具的頭部區域行，包括江蘇、南京、渝農等；2）綜合收益波動率較低、分紅預期強的國有大行；3）股息邏輯可能外溢的優質頭部股份行，例如招行等。博時基金認為，後市A股整體維持結構性行情的機率較大，指數層面的方向性突破條件尚不充分。配置上宜以均衡框架應對震盪：紅利資產作為底倉對沖波動，科技方向側重前期調整較充分、三季報盈利兌現能力可驗證的細分領域，結合業績視窗擇機而非追漲。資源品在供給約束與地緣溢價下仍具備階段性對沖價值，但需注意油價衝高對中下游成本的傳導。整體以結構選擇而非倉位博弈應對不確定性。截止2026年10月22日，紅利低波ETF華泰柏瑞（512890）近5年回報50.17％，在1244只產品中排在41位。投資者可將該ETF作為底倉配置，無股票賬戶的投資者也可透過其場外聯接基金進行配置（A類：007466；C類：007467；I類：022678；Y類：022951）。

【韓國船東長錦商船異軍突起 主導霍爾木茲海峽原油運輸】情報公司的資料表明，一家知名度不高的韓國船東9月主導了經霍爾木茲海峽進行的原油運輸，長錦商船旗下船舶的運輸量超過排名其後的三家船東總和。根據對情報公司Vortexa、Equasis和Signal Group提供的船舶追蹤及其他資料所作的分析，長錦商船旗下船舶經這條連線波斯灣與全球市場的水道運輸了1.056億桶原油，相當於上月經該海峽運輸石油總量的近40%。媒體根據上述資料計算，排名其後的三家企業，即又稱Bahri的沙烏地阿拉伯國家航運公司、科威特石油油輪公司，以及阿布扎比國家石油公司的航運部門，同期合計運輸了9730萬桶原油。該分析依據船舶所有權統計，不考慮船舶運營商。

Palm Oil Set for 3rd Straight Weekly Gain — Malaysian palm oil futures extended gains, holding above MYR 4,800 per tonne amid strength in rival edible oils and a tightening supply outlook linked to severe El Niño conditions and Indonesia's upcoming B50 biodiesel mandate. Robust exports also supported prices, with cargo surveyors reporting a 58.5%–78.4% surge in shipments during Oct. 1–20 from the same period in Sept. Festival-related buying from India, the world's largest palm oil importer, has been a key demand driver. The Malaysian Palm Oil Council expects prices to stay above MYR 4,600 in Nov., noting that India and China may increase their reliance on palm oil amid anticipated supply constraints in sunflower and soybean oils. Elevated energy prices further supported prices by strengthening biodiesel demand prospects. However, gains were tempered by softer food-sector demand amid lingering inflation pressures. For the week, futures were on track for a third consecutive weekly rise, up nearly 1% so far.

Malaysia Leading Index Rises 0.2% in August — Malaysia's leading economic index increased 0.2% month-on-month in August 2026, following an upwardly revised 0.6% rise in July. The slowdown reflected declines in real imports of other basic precious and non-ferrous metals (-0.6% vs 0.1% in July), the number of housing units approved (-0.3% vs 0.04%), and real imports of semiconductors (-0.7% vs 0.4%). These declines were partly offset by faster growth in the expected sales value of manufacturing (0.6% vs. 0.1%) and steady growth in real money supply M1 (at 0.1%). On an annual basis, the leading index climbed 2.2%, accelerating from an upwardly revised 1.5% in July. Meanwhile, the coincident index, a gauge of current economic conditions, inched down 0.1% month-on-month, matching the pace recorded in July.

【光迅科技公告披露近期生產經營情況：生產交付秩序正常 在手訂單儲備充足】光迅科技今日午間釋出關於公司近期生產經營情況的公告，截至目前，行業整體發展趨勢與公司前期在定期報告中公開披露的行業判斷保持一致，不存在發生重大不利變化的情況。公司緊抓市場機遇，依託領先的技術實力與高效的交付和服務能力，在國內頭部客戶群體中持續穩固核心供應商地位，經營業績實現穩步增長。截至本公告披露日，公司各項日常生產經營活動嚴格按照既定經營計劃有序開展，整體執行狀態平穩，未發生對公司經營產生重大不利影響的事項。公司生產交付秩序正常，研發與業務合作進展正常，公司圍繞光傳輸、光互連等方向的在研專案有序推進，與主要客戶的業務溝通與合作保持穩定。依託公司在全產業鏈佈局的核心優勢，公司目前高速光互聯及光傳輸等主要產品的市場需求旺盛，在手訂單儲備充足，業務基本面發展勢頭良好。

【中國移動研究院自研通智一體基站邁入商用階段】據中國移動研究院訊息，近日，中國移動研究院聯合中國移動紫金（江蘇）創新研究院共同打造的CIS-RAN無線智腦系統助力中國移動江蘇公司蘇州分公司中標蘇州市具身智慧機器人創新中心算力網路及“無本體”資料採集設施專案，CIS-RAN無線智腦系統將部署於蘇州市具身智慧機器人綜合創新中心。這是中國移動研究院自研通智一體基站首次實現商用簽約，標誌著該創新成果從原型邁入商用階段。

【231噸保供油品運往西藏巴青震中地區】10月22日22時33分，西藏那曲市巴青縣發生7.0級地震。地震發生後，中國石油、中國石化迅速啟動地震應急預案，231噸保供油品運往震中地區。經全面摸排統計，中國石油距震中100公里範圍內3座加油站，中國石化榮布加能站、迎賓大道加油站，站內房屋結構、儲油裝置、輸油管線、消防設施、電氣裝置等關鍵設施裝置經排查，暫未發現重大安全隱患、油品洩漏等問題。截至23日7時，中國石油西藏銷售公司調撥12臺油罐車共計231噸油品趕赴那曲巴青、索縣，確保震區油品供應。中國石化西藏石油組織開展各加能站應急物資儲備及補充工作，已在通往震區主要通道沿線的加能站開通抗震救災綠色通道。

【滬市半年報分紅4200億已落地，上證50平均股息率3.4%】10月23日，最新統計顯示，滬市上市公司（含科創板）2026年半年報現金分紅已完成派發超4200億元。年初以來，滬市公司已累計實施近1.7萬億現金分紅，近30家公司年內分紅超百億，隨著三季報的披露，一批可觀的三季報分紅也將陸續宣告。在藍籌公司持續分紅帶動下，滬市核心指數成分公司的股息率保持較高水平，高股息標的覆蓋航運、金融、消費、交通運輸等多個行業。以6月30日股價為基準，2025年度上證50指數成分公司平均股息率達到3.4%。資料顯示，股息率超過4%的上證50指數成分公司達18家，超過5%的有10家。上證180指數中的高股息標的數量更為豐富。資料顯示，股息率超過4%的上證180指數成分公司達到58家，超過5%的有33家。
【西藏巴青7.0級地震受傷人數升至65人】據那曲市抗震救災指揮部訊息，截至今日10時，經現場進一步排查統計，西藏巴青7.0級地震已造成65人受傷，其中重傷11人、輕傷54人。遇難人員數量、房屋及棚圈受損等其他災情資料暫未發生變化。經過各方救援力量持續奮戰，目前已安全轉移受災群眾12489人。震後災情拉網排查、搶險救援、群眾安置等各項工作仍在緊張有序推進。（央視）

【機構：第三季度全球PC出貨量同比下降21%】10月23日，根據Counterpoint Research初步資料，2026年第三季度全球PC出貨量同比下降21%至5700萬臺，環比下降13.8%。主要由於儲存及其他零部件成本持續高企，推動PC價格上漲，並對市場需求形成壓力。2026年第四季度全球PC出貨量預計將同比下降27%，2027年全年出貨量預計與2026年基本持平。其中，聯想2026年第三季度出貨量為1500萬臺，出貨量同比下降23%，市場份額為26.3%；惠普以1030萬臺的出貨量位居第二，同比下降31%，市場份額為18.1%；戴爾以760萬臺的出貨量位居第三，同比下降25%，市場份額為13.3%；蘋果出貨量同比下降11%至560萬臺，市場份額從上年同期的8.7%提升至9.8%；華碩出貨量為520萬臺，同比下降7%。
【勝宏科技：在手訂單飽滿 迭代產品推進順利】針對市場關注，證券時報記者獲悉，勝宏科技與核心客戶保持密切溝通，與客戶合作開發的研發迭代產品正順利推進當中。在AI算力、資料中心、高效能運算、光模組等關鍵領域，多款高階產品已實現大規模量產。訂單層面，公司目前在手訂單飽滿，訂單能見度處於歷史高位，部分客戶已釋放2027年至2028年長期需求，公司對後續生產經營及效益實現充滿信心。
【中國足協公開選聘女足國家隊主教練 】中國足球協會23日釋出通知，面向社會公開選聘國家女子足球隊主教練，報名時間截至10月28日。根據通知，新任主教練的任務目標包括持續提升女足國家隊競技水平和國際足聯排名，完成2027年女足世界盃、2028年洛杉磯奧運會女足專案比賽備戰參賽目標任務，挖掘和培養優秀青年足球人才，配合協會完善大國家隊體系建設。
【法國駐美大使在法美外交風波後履新 】法國駐美國大使館22日宣佈，新任駐美大使奧雷利安·勒舍瓦利耶已正式履新。此前，美國國務院因對法國批美言論不滿，遲遲不批准勒舍瓦利耶的任命。法新社援引使館方面訊息報道，勒舍瓦利耶20日向美國國務院禮賓司司長莫妮卡·克勞利遞交國書副本，“標誌著他開始履職”。

Rupee Rally Stalls on Rising Oil Prices, Dollar Demand — The Indian rupee hovered around 94.8 per dollar, easing slightly from multi-week highs as rising oil prices and a global flight to safety weighed on the currency, while persistent dollar demand threatened to limit further gains. Brent crude climbed to nearly USD 115 a barrel amid concerns over supply disruptions following Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, raising India’s import costs and potentially spurring further hedging by importers. Meanwhile, the rupee’s eight-session rally ended on Thursday as the currency reversed from a more than six-week high near 94.30. Although the RBI’s recent foreign-exchange measures have curbed dollar demand and provided some relief, they have not addressed underlying pressures from elevated oil prices and capital outflows.

【土耳其官員：COP31氣候大會將聚焦落實 】土耳其外交部副部長貝里斯·埃金吉22日說，即將在土耳其舉辦的《聯合國氣候變化框架公約》第三十一次締約方大會（COP31）將重點關注氣候政策的具體落實，力爭辦成一屆“落實的COP”。埃金吉在土耳其首都安卡拉舉辦的聯合國活動上表示，隨著全球就應對氣候變化的必要性與緊迫性已達成基本共識，全球氣候協商談判的重點越來越轉向具體落實。因此，COP31應重點圍繞可行的專案落實進行討論。

【iPhone Duo正式開售：貨源供應好於預期，溢價已“腰斬”至2000元】蘋果首款摺疊屏手機iPhone Duo正式開售。10月23日早上，蘋果上海靜安店門口聚集了首批來取iPhone Duo的人群。8點一到，大門開啟，在蘋果工作人員夾道歡迎中，消費者陸續進店取機。隨著iPhone Duo正式發售，黃牛們也開始聚集在蘋果靜安店的周圍，希望賺些差價。記者在現場看到，一位黃牛溢價4000元買了一臺1TB的iPhone Duo，如果512G版本加價在2000元上下。 截至10月23日上午8點，記者從得物App上看到，預售一週後，iPhone Duo各容量版本的加價空間均明顯收窄，多個版本溢價縮水幅度接近五成。  （澎湃新聞）
【中國移動召開5G-A低空智聯技術研討暨低空智聯網子鏈啟動會】據中國移動研究院訊息，10月21日，中國移動召開“5G-A低空智聯技術研討暨低空智聯網子鏈啟動會”，產、學、研、用各界專家共同研討低空智聯閘道器鍵技術與產業發展路徑，同時正式啟動低空智聯網子鏈工作、成立首批聯合攻關編隊。
【第140屆廣交會二期今天開展 首發展品煥新升級】10月23日，第140屆廣交會二期正式開展，展覽面積達51.5萬平方米，參展企業超1萬家。廣交會新品首發的主會場，二期計劃舉辦約170場的新品首發活動。同時，本屆廣交會還首次設定了新品首發展示區，這個區域的展品每一期都會進行展品更換，可以讓我們在活動釋出前先一飽眼福。現在展出的既有精美的瓷器、工藝品，也有保溫壺、毛巾、廚具等等再常見不過的日用品。
【巴基斯坦俾路支省發生5.1級地震】當地時間10月23日4時27分，巴基斯坦俾路支省發生5.1級地震，震中位於俾路支省達爾班丁以東約15公里處，震源深度53公里。（央視新聞）

【科大智慧：重新向香港聯交所遞交H股發行上市申請】科大智慧10月23日公告，公司已於2026年10月22日向香港聯合交易所有限公司重新遞交了發行境外上市股份（H股）並在香港聯交所主機板掛牌上市的申請，並於同日在香港聯交所網站刊登了本次發行上市的申請資料。該申請材料為公司按照香港證券及期貨事務監察委員會及香港聯交所的要求編制和刊發，為草擬版本，其所載資料可能會適時作出更新及修訂。公司本次發行上市尚需取得中國證券監督管理委員會、香港證監會和香港聯交所等相關政府機關、監管機構、證券交易所的批准、核准或備案，並需綜合考慮市場情況以及其他因素方可實施，該事項仍存在不確定性。

【一家鮮為人知的韓國船東9月份主導了霍爾木茲海峽石油運輸】市場情報機構的資料顯示，9月份，一家鮮為人知的韓國船東在霍爾木茲海峽的石油運輸中佔據了主導地位；該集團旗下船隻運輸的石油總量，超過了緊隨其後的三家船東的總和。根據市場情報機構Vortexa、Equasis和Signal Group提供的船舶追蹤及其他資料分析，韓國長錦商船集團（Sinokor Group）旗下的船隻透過這條連線波斯灣與全球市場的航道，運輸了1.056億桶原油。這一數字約佔上個月經由該航道運輸的石油總量的40%。根據機構基於上述資料進行的計算，排名其後的三家企業——沙特國家航運公司（Bahri）、科威特石油油輪公司以及阿布扎比國家石油公司（ADNOC）旗下的航運部門——在同期內的運輸總量合計為9730萬桶。該分析基於船舶所有權，而非船舶運營商。
特朗普稱加拿大龐巴迪公司將在德克薩斯州、堪薩斯州和印第安納州投資2.7億美元。
【回盛生物：泰樂菌素、泰萬菌素原料藥價格均處於歷史較低位置】回盛生物近日接受機構調研時表示，目前泰樂菌素、泰萬菌素原料藥價格均處於歷史較低位置。原料藥價格有一定週期性，受市場需求、行業供給、生產成本等多方面因素影響。公司主要透過技術創新、最佳化生產工藝、完善產業佈局、開拓海外市場、拓展產品適應範圍等方式，提升產品質量，降低生產成本，增強競爭優勢，提升盈利水平。

【特朗普認為自己有權競選第三個總統任期】美國總統特朗普週四表示，儘管他承認憲法似乎禁止他尋求連任，但他認為自己有“再次競選總統的權利”。在美國艾奧瓦州舉行的一場中期選舉競選集會上，特朗普在談及自己的政治地位時說道：“我不知道你們的下一任總統會是誰。據我所知——雖然我不敢百分之百確定——法律似乎規定我不被允許再次參選。但是，他們在第二次選舉中欺騙了我們。我認為自己有權再次參選，因為他們作弊了。”
【納真科技2027年晶片產能已被客戶鎖定】記者獲悉，納真科技位於青島經濟技術開發區王臺街道的InP鐳射器晶片工廠已完成潔淨廠房裝修，MOCVD等核心工藝裝置正陸續進場安裝除錯。據瞭解，該工廠2027年中開始量產，隨著逐步產能爬坡，2027年全年產能預計超1億顆，疊加現有光晶片產能，年度整體產能已被客戶訂單需求全部覆蓋。 (財聯社)

【山東海化集團成立新材料科技公司 註冊資本1億】天眼查App顯示，近日，山東海化新材料科技發展有限公司成立，法定代表人為閆志坤，註冊資本1億元人民幣，經營範圍含新材料技術研發、化工產品生產、化工產品銷售等。股東資訊顯示，該公司由山東海化集團有限公司全資持股。

【網傳家電國補正在退場是假的】在社交平臺上，多個博主此前發帖說“家電國補即將停止”。配合著“最後機會”“額度沒了”的話術，讓不少正打算趁“雙十一”換家電的人，一下子不知道該不該等。事實上，今年家電以舊換新補貼政策仍在實施。國家發展改革委9月30日公佈，今年第四批625億元消費品以舊換新資金已下達。 家電經銷商和網路博主很可能是利用消費者的焦慮心理，暗示“等雙十一再下單就趕不上國補”，以此催促消費者提前下單。 實際上，國補的發放工作有節奏和計劃，並不像網路博主所說的一樣緊張。商務部等5部門辦公廳（室）《關於做好2026年家電以舊換新、數碼和智慧產品購新補貼工作的通知》中明確要求：各地要科學制定補貼資金使用及兌付計劃，按月均衡使用，並做好月內每週和跨月、跨季度之間的平穩銜接。記者致電了安徽、重慶、江西等地的商務主管部門，對方均表示國補額度充足，不存在已經用完的情況。（央視財經）
【秋假國內機票價格較國慶便宜三成】滴滴機票資料顯示，多地預計在中小學秋假首日迎來出行小高峰，但國內航班預售價仍維持淡季價格，秋假期間票價整體比國慶黃金週便宜30%，以11月初放假的濟南為例，秋假首日去往上海、貴陽、昆明等地仍有1折至3折機票在售。

【中銀國際：上調2026年油價預測9%至94美元/桶 2027年預測上調22%】中銀國際釋出研報稱，隨著中東地緣政治緊張局勢升級，該地區兩條重要海峽的通行受到影響，沙烏地阿拉伯的石油基礎設施也面臨威脅，油價已飆升至5月以來的最高水平。鑑於當前情況短期內難以解決，該行預期油價將在較長時期內維持高位，將2026年的油價預測上調9%至94美元/桶，2027年的油價預測上調22%至90美元/桶。該行維持石油行業“中立”評級，並更看好中國海洋石油(00883)和中國石油股份(00857)等上游業務佔比較高的公司。

【馬石油、道達爾能源及三井物產簽署合資協議，推進馬來西亞南部碳封存中心建設】10月23日，馬來西亞國家石油公司（PETRONAS）、道達爾能源（TotalEnergies）及三井物產（Mitsui）宣佈簽署合資協議，將共同開發馬來西亞半島近海二氧化碳封存區域，作為馬來西亞南部碳捕集與封存（CCS）中心的重要組成部分。專案首期計劃利用馬來西亞半島近海一處已枯竭氣田，預計每年最多可注入500萬噸二氧化碳，目標最早於2031年開始注入。三方將成立專門的合資公司，推進專案開發、商業化及運營，並在最終投資決策前進一步完善技術和商業方案。
印尼央行：將繼續保持SRBI的吸引力。

【馬斯克為美共和黨中期選舉捐款超4.45億美元】隨著10月前兩週再次向旗下超級政治行動委員會注入資金，埃隆·馬斯克在本輪選舉週期中的捐款總額現已超過4.45億美元，成為此類組織有史以來最大的捐助者之一。美國聯邦選舉委員會的申報檔案顯示，這位全球首富在10月前兩週向美國政治行動委員會(America PAC)投入了7700萬美元，力圖幫助共和黨人在11月的中期選舉中獲勝。

Corn Holds Near Two-Month Low — Corn futures held around $4.6 per bushel, near their lowest level in more than two months as weak export shipments and US harvest pressure outweighed stronger new-crop sales. USDA data showed US corn export sales for the 2026/27 marketing year rose 36% week over week to 60.1 million bushels in the week ended October 15, exceeding analysts' estimates and signaling solid demand for future deliveries. However, export inspections plunged nearly 49% to 672,475 metric tons, marking the lowest weekly total since October 2024 and highlighting a slowdown in actual shipments. The US harvest reached 44% completion as of October 18, up from 33% a week earlier, with dry weather across much of the Midwest expected to help fieldwork advance. The USDA projects record US production of 16.03 billion bushels and ending stocks of 1.849 billion bushels for 2026/27, reinforcing concerns over ample availability. These supply pressures continue to limit the market's recovery despite stronger export bookings.

Soybeans Rebound on Strong Export Demand — Soybean futures rose toward $12.6 per bushel, rebounding from a two-month low reached on October 21, as strong export demand led by China helped end an eight-session losing streak. The USDA reported 2.84 million metric tons of net US soybean export sales for the 2026/27 marketing year in the week ended October 15, sharply above 574,900 tons a week earlier. China accounted for 2.18 million tons, while export shipments climbed 75% week over week to 2.02 million tons, up 88% from the four-week average. A separate USDA announcement also confirmed a sale of 202,000 tons to China. Still, futures remained on track for a second consecutive weekly loss as the advancing US harvest and expectations for a large crop continued to weigh on prices. The USDA projects US soybean production at 4.56 billion bushels for the 2026/27 marketing year. However, analysts suggested harvest-related pressure was easing as fieldwork neared completion.

Indonesia Money Supply Growth Edges Up — Indonesia’s broad money supply (M2) rose 8.3% year-on-year to a record IDR 10,587.9 trillion in September 2026, edging up from 8.2% in the previous month. The increase was mainly driven by narrow money supply (M1), which grew 9%, while quasi-money growth accelerated to 7.3%. By component, net claims on the central government (Pempus) rebounded 24.4% after declining 7% in August, while net foreign assets returned to growth of 1% following a 6.6% contraction. However, credit growth eased to 12.7% in September from 13.3% in the previous month.

US Natgas Prices Fall Back to 2-Month Low — US natural gas prices fell back to $2.76 per MMBtu on Friday, their lowest level in two months, as mild weather forecasts weighed on expected heating demand. Above-average temperatures are expected across the Midwest and East through November 5, according to Commodity Weather Group, likely limiting gas consumption. This outweighed support from a smaller-than-usual storage build, strong LNG feedgas demand, and lower production. EIA data showed that energy companies added 77 bcf of natural gas to storage in the week ended October 16, below the 86 bcf injected during the same week last year and the five-year average of 87 bcf. Meanwhile, average gas flows to the nine major US LNG export facilities rose to 18.2 bcfd in October, up from 17.9 bcfd in September. On the supply side, natural gas production across the Lower 48 states averaged 111.4 bcfd this month, down from record highs of 113.3 bcfd in August and September.

Growing concerns over the sustainability of AI investments, a key driver of US economic growth, also prompted markets to reduce expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Philippines 10-Year Yield Hits 8-Year High — The Philippines’ 10-year government bond yield climbed to 8.10% in late October, its highest level since October 2018, following the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas’ (BSP) larger-than-expected rate hike. The central bank raised its key policy rate by 50 bps to 5.50%, exceeding expectations for a 25 bps increase and marking its fourth consecutive hike this year. The decision came as annual inflation accelerated to 7.2% in September from 6.1% in August, overshooting forecasts of 6.6% and matching April’s three-year high. Higher global oil prices amid the ongoing Middle East tensions and potential El Niño-related supply disruptions threaten to sustain inflationary pressures, while peso weakness raises the cost of imported goods. Meanwhile, subdued demand at recent government bond auctions added to upward pressure on yields, as investors demanded higher returns to compensate for persistent inflation risks.

European Gas Prices Extend Rally — European natural gas prices extended their rally, rising to €91/MWh on Friday to hit a fresh multi-year high as ongoing disruptions to Persian Gulf supplies kept the global LNG market tight ahead of winter. Japan’s 10-Year Yield Drops on Haven Demand — Japan’s 10-year government bond yield fell by more than 10 basis points to around 2.76% on Friday, reaching its lowest level since early August as a global selloff in technology and artificial intelligence stocks drove investors toward safer assets. Meanwhile, Brent crude surged 4% to US$114 a barrel after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia heightened concerns over Middle East supply disruptions, raising inflation risks. On the domestic front, Chinese AI startup DeepSeek had raised about US$15 billion offered a potential positive signal for the domestic AI sector, although it failed to offset broader market weakness. Notable laggards included SMIC (-3.0%), Genscript Biotech (-9.7%), Lenovo (-3.1%), AIA (-0.6%), and Wuxi Biologics (-1.5%). For the week, Hang Seng declined by more than 6%.

China Stocks Slide to Over 2-Month Low — The Shanghai Composite lost 1.5% to 3,602 on Friday, while the Shenzhen Component slid 2.1% to 11,118, with both indexes hitting their lowest levels in more than two months as steep losses in semiconductor and technology stocks weighed on the market. The selloff mirrored broader declines across Asian markets following overnight losses on Wall Street, as mounting concerns over the sustainability and potential returns of artificial intelligence investments pressured technology stocks. Domestically, MiniMax Group Inc. and Z.AI Co. have lost a combined $150 billion in market value from their respective peaks amid intensifying competition and the prospect of rival listings. Potential IPOs by DeepSeek and Moonshot AI could further divert investor capital from MiniMax and Zhipu, two of China’s few listed pure-play AI firms. Notable laggards included Cambricon Technologies (-3.7%), SMIC (-2.9%), Zhongji Innolight (-3.6%), Eoptolink Technology (-6.1%) and NAURA Technology (-1.9%).

【Guan Tao: Take a rational view of overseas market turbulence spillovers】Guan Tao, chief economist at Huafu Securities, said recent domestic market weakness reflects sentiment volatility after rising geopolitical tensions and widening divergence in overseas tech stocks, but key market drivers remain intact. He listed four market-positive points: China’s long-term favorable economic fundamentals are unchanged; the certainty of stronger, more effective policy support remains; innovation momentum is gradually releasing; and valuation advantages in Chinese assets remain to be exploited. Under dual forces of market demand and policy guidance, China’s growth is shifting toward higher quality and structural upgrade. Investors should treat recent volatility rationally, focus on earnings-recovery stories, and remain cautiously optimistic on medium-to-long-term market prospects. Guan added that deepening capital-market financing and investment reform is two-way: authorities must strengthen institutional support for long-term capital and investors must adopt long-term, value-driven, rational investment habits. The current episode is a litmus test for the market’s ability to move away from momentum trading toward greater maturity.

Platinum Sinks to 11-Month Low — Platinum futures dropped below $1,560 an ounce, hitting their lowest level since November 2025, as a liquidity-driven selloff swept across precious metals amid a broader stock market rout. Growing concerns over the sustainability of AI investment triggered a sharp decline in US stocks and a rally in Treasuries, prompting investors to liquidate gold and other liquid assets to meet margin calls and cover losses elsewhere. Non-yielding metals also remained under pressure from rising oil prices, which heightened inflation concerns and strengthened expectations that interest rates could stay elevated for longer. Platinum also faces fundamental headwinds, with the World Platinum Investment Council forecasting a 265,000-ounce market surplus in 2026, as weaker investment demand and softer jewelry consumption weigh on the outlook. Automotive demand is also expected to decline 4%, partly offset by a projected 5% increase in industrial demand.

【管濤：理性看待海外資本市場動盪對國內的溢位影響】受地緣衝突緊張局勢升級、海外科技股行情演進分歧加大的影響，近期國內資本市場調整加劇，反映了市場情緒的波動。華福證券首席經濟學家管濤在接受採訪時表示，從以下方面看，中國資產的配置價值更加凸顯，資本市場走勢與之存在一定錯位。一是經濟長期向好的基本面沒有變；二是政策加力提效的確定性沒有變；三是創新動能正在逐步釋放；四是市場估值優勢有待挖掘。管濤表示，在市場需求和政策引導的雙重驅動下，中國經濟向新向優、結構升級趨勢明確，投資者應理性看待市場震盪，把握業績修復主線，對市場中長期走勢保持審慎樂觀。同時，深化資本市場投融資綜合改革是“雙向奔赴”，既要從制度上不斷完善長錢長投的資本市場生態環境，也要投資者不斷強化長期投資、價值投資、理性投資的投資理念。當前正是前述投資理念的“試金石”，是中國資本市場擺脫“追漲殺跌”、走向更加成熟的又一次大考。（證券時報）

New Zealand Dollar Hovers Near 1-Month High — The New Zealand dollar edged up to $0.569, trading near a one-month high, as expectations of further monetary tightening by the Reserve Bank supported the currency. Although inflation eased slightly more than expected in the third quarter, analysts expect price pressures to pick up again, potentially pushing inflation well above 4% in the fourth quarter and keeping it outside the RBNZ’s 1-3% target range for longer than previously anticipated. This outlook was reinforced by rising energy prices amid heightened tensions in the Middle East. Markets are almost certain that the central bank will deliver a third rate hike next week, bringing the OCR to 3.0%. Beyond that, some economists project the OCR to climb to 3.75% by the first quarter of next year or peak at 4% in the second half of 2027. The kiwi has gained 0.7% this week, marking its second consecutive weekly advance.

【China Association of Automobile Manufacturers' Fu Bingfeng: Firms must prioritize breakthroughs in key core technologies】China Association of Automobile Manufacturers vice chairman and secretary-general Fu Bingfeng said at the 2026 China Auto Supply Chain Conference that shifting geopolitics and regional trade protectionism have severely disrupted auto supply-chain stability. He said that at the start of the '15th Five-Year' period maintaining volume and improving quality is the development theme and urged industry and firms to prioritize breakthroughs in key core technologies—vehicle-grade chips, in-vehicle operating systems, solid-state batteries, new electronic/electrical architectures and basic industrial software—to shore up supply-chain security. He also called for deeper integration of electrification, intelligence and green development, stronger OEM-supplier coordination and cross-sector cooperation, and co-innovation between vehicle makers and domestic and foreign core suppliers to boost industry resilience and innovation efficiency.

Australia 10Y Yield Falls to 7-Week Low — Australia’s 10-year government bond yield fell below 5.2%, hitting a seven-week low as a tech-led global equity selloff sparked demand for safe-haven assets. Concerns over the enormous capital requirements of AI development and the sustainability of heavy data centre investment fueled fears that a slowdown in spending could weigh on economic growth. The concerns triggered a rally in US Treasuries, spilling over into the Australian bond market. The move came despite oil prices surpassing $113 per barrel, threatening renewed inflation pressures. RBA Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser warned that the inflation outlook remained materially worse due partly to elevated oil prices, stressing the need to anchor inflation expectations ahead of the November 3 meeting, where policymakers will consider a fifth rate hike this year. Markets currently imply a 64% chance of a quarter-point rise in November. Focus now turns to Q3 inflation numbers due next week for further clues on the policy outlook.

【Analyst: Japan's 2.4% underlying CPI raises odds of a higher terminal rate】Eamonn Sheridan says Japan's September underlying inflation accelerated. Despite government fuel subsidies, goods and services price gains widened. Core CPI ex‑fresh food but including fuel rose 2.1% YoY (in line); core CPI ex‑fresh food and fuel — the BOJ's preferred gauge — climbed from 1.9% to 2.4% YoY. Goods inflation rose to 2.8% from 2.6% and services inflation to 1.5% from 1.2%, signalling firms are passing higher wages to customers. Rising fuel costs tied to the prolonged Middle East conflict, yen weakness lifting import prices, and robust AI‑related demand have bluntly undermined the subsidy effect. The print reinforces market bets on a BOJ hike in December and shifts attention to how high policy rates could go; BOJ wording in next week's Outlook Report may shape expectations for rates after December as it balances broader inflation against signs of cooling labour market and domestic demand.

【Japan weighs phasing out gasoline subsidies from December as costs climb】Japan is considering cutting gasoline subsidies as early as December, two ruling-party officials said, citing rapidly rising program costs. The emergency measure, introduced in March to blunt fuel-price inflation and keep average regular gasoline around 170 yen per liter (≈$1.09), now costs tens of billions of dollars a month and is quickly depleting a 3.1 trillion yen supplementary budget approved in June. Under a plan being discussed, weekly payments to fuel distributors would be phased down, lifting the national average retail price to about 175 yen/l in December and roughly 180 yen/l in January.

【商務部消費促進司負責人談2026年前三季度我國消費市場情況】前三季度，商務部認真貫徹落實黨中央、國務院決策部署，深入實施提振消費專項行動，出臺一系列促消費政策措施，推動消費市場規模穩步擴大、居民消費結構持續最佳化，為經濟增長髮揮重要作用。一、消費“主引擎”作用持續鞏固，超大規模市場優勢日益凸顯。前三季度，最終消費支出對經濟增長的貢獻率為46.7%，高於上半年0.7個百分點，拉動GDP增長2.1個百分點，持續保持經濟增長第一拉動力。二、“商品+服務”消費並重發展，保持良好增長勢頭。前三季度，社會消費商品和服務零售總額同比（下同）增長2.6%，增速比1-8月快0.1個百分點。其中，服務零售額增長5.0%，增速高於商品零售額4個百分點。全國居民人均消費支出2.2萬元，比上年同期名義增長3.6%，扣除價格因素，實際增長2.7%。三、社會消費品零售總額有所回升，商品消費基本面良好。9月份社會消費品零售總額增長1.1%，增速比8月份快0.7個百分點，除汽車以外消費品零售額增長3.9%。前三季度，社會消費品零售總額增長1.1%，在去年同期高基數情況下實現平穩增長。限額以上單位16大類商品中，9類商品保持增長，其中6類商品增速在5%以上。四、綠色、智慧、健康消費需求旺盛，向新向好特徵明顯。部分升級類商品較快增長，限額以上單位通訊器材、化妝品零售額分別增長18.1%、6.1%。商務部商務大資料顯示，前三季度重點平臺智慧眼鏡銷售額增長1.1倍、外骨骼助力器銷售額增長46.4%、具身智慧機器人銷售額增長22.6%、有機食品銷售額增長6.4%。據汽車流通協會資料，9月份新能源乘用車零售滲透率達67.0%。（商務部）

Asian Stocks Track Wall Street Lower — Asian stocks fell sharply on Friday, mirroring overnight losses on Wall Street as growing concerns over the sustainability of artificial intelligence investments triggered a broad selloff in technology shares. Semiconductor makers, memory chip producers and other AI-related companies recorded significant declines, while investors moved toward safer assets such as government bonds and the yen. Sentiment was further weighed down by escalating tensions in the Middle East, following reports that the US and Israel had drawn up plans for possible renewed strikes against Iran after next month’s midterm elections. Technology-heavy markets in Japan and South Korea led regional losses, with the Nikkei 225 and KOSPI Composite each falling nearly 2%.

Yen Rallies on Haven Buying, Strong Inflation — The Japanese yen strengthened toward 156 per dollar on Friday, reaching its highest level in five weeks as a global selloff in technology and artificial intelligence stocks boosted demand for safe-haven assets. The equity downturn intensified this week after Meta Platforms’ plans to increase capital expenditure reignited concerns that technology companies may take on more debt to fund the AI buildout. In Japan, data showed that both headline and core inflation rose 2.1% year-on-year in September, marking their highest levels in nine months as yen weakness and elevated energy prices drove up import costs. With underlying inflation returning above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target, market expectations for another interest rate hike this year have strengthened. The BOJ is widely anticipated to leave rates unchanged at its upcoming meeting, potentially paving the way for a rate increase in December.

Singapore Home Price Growth Confirmed at Nearly 2-Year High — Private home prices in Singapore rose by 1.4% quarter-on-quarter in the third quarter of 2026, in line with initial estimates and marking the fastest growth since the fourth quarter of 2024. The latest result accelerated from a 0.5% increase in the previous quarter, as landed property prices climbed 2.9%, up from 2.5% in Q2, while non-landed prices rebounded 1.0% after falling 0.1%. By region, prices in the Outside Central Region rose 2.3%, recovering from a 0.1% decline, while gains in the Core Central Region moderated to 0.3% from 1.8%. Prices in the Rest of Central Region were unchanged after falling 1.2% in the previous quarter. Meanwhile, private residential rents increased 1.3%, accelerating from 0.7% in Q2, supported by stronger rental growth in the Outside Central Region. The government will maintain a high level of housing supply, with 9,320 private residential units on the 2026 Confirmed List, more than 50% above the 10-year annual average.

The 10-year JGB yield slid about 9 bps to 2.79%; the 20-year fell 5.5 bps. The move came despite a key Japanese inflation gauge rising above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target this year for the first time, a data point that had supported market bets on a December BOJ rate hike. Market participants said focus shifted to growth risk and AI-driven volatility, temporarily reducing the market’s emphasis on inflation; long-duration bonds attracted demand for diversification and carry.

【中信期貨：能源價格上漲強化美聯儲緊縮預期，黃金短期維持震盪偏弱判斷】中東局勢升級使能源供應風險重新成為市場關注焦點，油價上漲對黃金的影響開始更多體現為貨幣政策約束。海灣能源設施遇襲及霍爾木茲海峽通航風險升溫，推升原油供應風險溢價，也使美國通脹回落面臨新的不確定性。在此前通脹已表現出較強黏性的背景下，能源價格持續上漲可能進一步延長美聯儲維持限制性政策的時間，壓制市場對未來寬鬆空間的預期。美聯儲政策定價正在從10月按兵不動轉向關注12月是否進一步加息。美聯儲主席近期強調政策將逐次會議評估，未對後續利率路徑作出明確承諾，紐約聯儲官員亦釋放年內仍可能加息的訊號。當前10月維持利率不變仍是市場基準情景，但油價上漲疊加通脹資料偏強，使12月進一步收緊的預期有所強化。對黃金而言，短期關鍵在於市場是否繼續上修終端利率預期，以及美債收益率能否隨之回落。地緣衝突對黃金的影響存在兩條相反的傳導路徑。一方面，衝突升級增加避險需求；另一方面，能源供應衝擊推升通脹風險，並透過美聯儲政策預期抬高黃金持有成本。近期金價承壓表明，市場對利率路徑的重新定價暫時壓過避險買盤，後續需重點觀察油價上漲是否進一步傳導至通脹預期和實際利率。中長期看，黃金配置需求仍具韌性。中國央行延續增持黃金，海外黃金ETF保持資金淨流入，反映官方儲備多元化及機構資產配置需求尚未逆轉。但在短期貨幣政策預期重新收緊的環境下，配置資金更多體現為下方支撐，難以立即推動金價重回上行趨勢。（中信期貨）

【Japan manufacturing expansion slows to seven-month low】Japan's manufacturing expansion slowed to a seven-month low in October as output and new orders growth eased, S&P Global's preliminary PMI showed. The manufacturing PMI fell to 53.3 in October from 54.1 in September; manufacturers' new orders and output growth were the weakest since March, and private-sector new export growth slowed to a four-month low. Manufacturing employment rose modestly, while purchasing increased and inventories rose at the fastest pace in nearly four years. S&P Global Japan services PMI business activity index rose to 52.0 from 51.3, with activity and sales gains accelerating. S&P Global Market Intelligence economist Usama Bhatty said: "The preliminary October PMIs show overall Japanese business activity growth was flat month-on-month and remained below the year-to-date average."

【Rumors that China appliance purchase subsidy is ending are false — NDRC says funds allocated, deadline Dec 31, 2026】Social posts by appliance dealers claiming the national appliance purchase subsidy will be taken offline on Oct 15 are false and are prompting “buy now” pressure ahead of Double 11. A widely shared screenshot cited the Oct 15 date, but the National Development and Reform Commission said on Sept 30 that the fourth batch of 62.5 bln yuan in ultra-long special sovereign bonds to support trade-in consumption has been allocated. By convention the subsidy’s final usage deadline is Dec 31, 2026, not Oct 15.

Japanese Shares Follow Wall Street Lower — The Nikkei 225 Index dropped 1.6% to around 61,900 on Friday, hitting its lowest levels in nearly three months and tracking a tech-led selloff on Wall Street overnight amid mounting concerns about the artificial intelligence trade. Semiconductor makers, memory chip producers and other AI-linked stocks suffered heavy losses, while investors shifted toward safer assets, including government bonds and the yen. Market sentiment was further dampened by rising tensions in the Middle East, following reports that the US and Israel had prepared plans for potential renewed strikes against Iran after next month’s midterm elections. Major technology stocks led the decline, with Kioxia falling 7.6%, Advantest dropping 4.2%, SoftBank Group losing 7.5%, Tokyo Electron sliding 6% and Fujikura retreating 6.8%. Financial and industrial shares also weakened, while consumer stocks proved more resilient. For the week, the Nikkei has declined by more than 5%.

Japan Manufacturing Growth Eases to 7-Month Low — The S&P Global Japan Manufacturing PMI declined to 53.3 in October 2026 from 54.1 in September, falling below market forecasts of 54.5, preliminary estimates showed. It was the slowest expansion in the manufacturing sector since March, as firms recorded slower increases in output and new orders, with both growing at their weakest rates in seven months. Employment continued to increase, with job creation rising moderately. Purchasing activity also increased, contributing to the largest accumulation of stocks of purchases in almost four years. Meanwhile, suppliers’ delivery times lengthened substantially. On the price front, input and output costs continued to rise. Looking ahead, business sentiment remained positive.

【衛星應用智慧體生態平臺在上海釋出】近日，上海浦東釋出“衛星應用智慧體生態平臺”。該平臺採用“一主兩輔”架構：“一主”為衛星智慧體應用平臺，支援行業夥伴低程式碼釋出智慧體；“兩輔”為大模型服務平臺和衛星資料服務平臺，實現太空算力隨取隨用、多源衛星資料隨需呼叫。在現場，四批共16家生態夥伴簽約，包括國星宇航、商湯智慧等，覆蓋高校、科研機構及衛星、AI、資料企業，“研—造—算—用”鏈條初步成形。同時舉行“東太空”號衛星入軌儀式，該衛星將與同組衛星開展萬瓦級液冷流體迴路、超大尺寸展開式輻冷翼、全域鐳射通訊網路、基礎大模型在軌訓練等關鍵技術驗證。

Japan Composite PMI Stays at 4-Month Low — Japan’s S&P Global Composite PMI Business Activity Index held steady at 52.3 in October 2026, unchanged from September’s final reading, flash data showed. This marked the 19th consecutive month of private-sector expansion, although growth remained at its slowest pace since May. Stronger services activity was accompanied by the slowest increase in manufacturing output since March. New orders grew at their weakest pace in three months, while new export orders continued to rise. Employment growth slowed to a 14-month low, with hiring trends diverging between sectors, while backlogs of work increased further. On the price front, input costs rose sharply, but selling price inflation eased to a four-month low. Meanwhile, persistent inflation concerns weighed on business sentiment, with year-ahead output expectations falling to their lowest level since July.

【CITIC Securities stays bullish on domestic semiconductor components and equipment chain】CITIC Securities says the 2026 Bay Chip Expo expanded, drawing over 6,500 professional buyers and showcasing new domestic equipment and process technologies. Equipment orders stayed strong in Q3 2026; industry players expect demand to remain robust for more than three years, and some firms see the current order acceleration extending into 2028–29. CITIC expects AI-driven global capacity expansion and process upgrades, together with domestic substitution, to boost Chinese suppliers' orders and market share, and remains positive on the domestic semiconductor components and equipment chain.
【我國東南沿海將迎強降雨 北方多地氣溫起伏大】今明天（10月23日至24日），我國東南沿海地區降雨將發展增強，新疆大範圍雨雪持續，需注意防範。氣溫方面，我國中東部今明天以升溫為主，不過新一股冷空氣已經在路上，25日至27日將東移南下，給華北和東北部分地區帶來明顯降溫。

【日元兌美元上漲 股市下跌推高避險需求】日元週五延續漲勢，表現優於所有其他主要貨幣，全球股市下跌推高了避險資產的需求。週五早盤日元兌美元匯率在東京交易時段上漲0.4%，至156.17；日元週四上漲0.9%，觸及9月下旬以來的最高水平。日元兌歐元週四上漲1%。新一輪科技和人工智慧(AI)相關企業的業績令人失望，這讓市場風險情緒承壓，與此同時中東緊張局勢升級推高了油價。美國國債價格上漲，美元小幅走低。
紐約期銀日內跌1%，現報54.44美元/盎司。

【娃哈哈集團法定代表人、董事長許思敏被曝辭職】10月22日，記者從知情人士處獲悉，杭州娃哈哈集團有限公司法定代表人、董事長兼總經理許思敏辭職。上述人士表示，許思敏還未完全離開公司，接任許思敏的具體人選，娃哈哈內部已有相關討論，仍未最終敲定。一位與娃哈哈集團有勞動糾紛訴訟的娃哈哈前員工也向記者表示，他與娃哈哈集團的案件原定在下月開庭，但在收到開庭傳票的當日下午，該案所屬法院工作人員電話告知他，因娃哈哈集團法定代表人辭職，案子開庭日期可能會變更。（澎湃新聞）
